subject: Walz Drops Out

body:

| Friends, It finally happened.
After months of pressure and mounting scrutiny, Tim Walz is no longer running for reelection. When forced to answer for the record he left behind — the failures, the scandals, the excuses — he couldn’t withstand the spotlight.
That tells you everything you need to know.
This moment creates a real opening. Minnesota voters are paying attention. The media narrative is shifting. And for the first time in a long time, Democrats are on defense.
But moments like this don’t win elections on their own. They only matter if we act.
National Democrats will rush in to try to contain the damage, rewrite history, and prop up a replacement who will carry on the same failed agenda under a different name. If we don’t press the advantage now, they’ll succeed.
That’s why we need resources immediately — to hold Democrats accountable, to define this race early, and to drive turnout in southern Minnesota’s First Congressional District.
We know how to win here. This is a turning point for Minnesota. Help us seize it.
If you’re able, please contribute today so we can keep the pressure on and deliver another strong victory in CD1.

subject: I was sixteen when I lied to join the Marines.
body:

My name is **Corporal Frank S. Wright** , United States Marine Corps, retired. I'm a hundred years old now -- one of the last living Marine Raiders of World War II.In January 1942, just weeks after the attack on Pearl Harbor, I quit high school in Arkansas and walked into the enlistment office. I was sixteen -- too young, too skinny, and too light to qualify. The sergeant told me to come back when I was heavier.So I went home, ate all the bananas I could find, and stuffed five pounds' worth into my pockets before stepping on that scale again.I passed. I lied about my age. And I became a Marine.

After boot camp, I volunteered to join the **4th Marine Raiders** , America's first special operations unit.They asked me why I wanted to join. I said, _" Because I want to fight."_Our commanding officer was **James Roosevelt** , the President's son -- a good man, the kind who never gave an order he wouldn't do himself. We were trained to land first, fight behind enemy lines, and take the beaches nobody else could reach.From **Guadalcanal** to **New Georgia** , from the jungles of the Solomons to the black sand of **Iwo Jima** , we fought to free the Pacific.On **Guam** , I was stabbed in the stomach during hand-to-hand combat. On **Iwo Jima** , I was hit by machine-gun fire and knocked unconscious. Both times, my men thought I was gone. Somehow, I wasn't.When I came to, I saw the flag rising on Mount Suribachi. Every ship in the harbor sounded its horn. I had tears in my eyes then, and I still do when I think about it.That flag meant freedom still lived.

There were dark days too...On Guadalcanal, I caught malaria and ended up in a field hospital -- but when my unit was preparing to move out, I couldn't stand being left behind.I slipped out and rejoined them. I'll now admit, I was always a little rebellious. When the war ended, I became a drill instructor, helping shape the next generation of Marines. I was in my twenties, carrying wounds inside and out.For more than a decade, I didn't share my stories. I kept them locked away, like many of my brothers did. Over the years, I began to open up and share my story with friends, family, and others who wanted to know about the realities of the battlefield at the Pacific Front.Now, more than ever, the **American Veterans Center** has given me the opportunity to share them -- on the stage at the **Annual Conference** , and by capturing them on film for future generations. Not just my story, but those of the men who never came home, and those who are no longer here to tell theirs.

Not just my story, but those of the men who never came home, and those who are no longer here to tell theirs. They've given old Marines like me a place to share what we lived through, to look young cadets and future service members in the eye and say, "This is what it means to serve."They've brought veterans from every generation together -- to remember, to teach, and to inspire. And every year, the American Veterans Center Annual Conference gives us something rare -- a gathering where history stands shoulder to shoulder with the future.It's where I've met cadets who listen with the same wide eyes I once had at sixteen. It's where old comrades find each other again, and where we all remember that the values we fought for -- courage, duty, honor -- are still being carried forward.It's a living bridge between those who fought for freedom and those who will defend it next. The National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C., where America gathers to honor its heroes. The Annual Veterans Conference each November, where we share stories and pass the torch to those who will serve next. The preservation of our stories through documentaries and oral histories -- so that when we are gone, the lessons remain. At my age, I don't take many things for granted. But I still believe in this country -- in what it stands for, and in the people who keep its history alive.If you believe that too, I ask you to help the American Veterans Center continue its work. So that long after the last of us is gone, our voices will still be heard -- reminders of what America can be when its people stand together.Thank you for remembering. Thank you for caring. And thank you for keeping faith with those who served.Semper Fidelis, Frank S. Wright Corporal, U.S. Marine Corps (Ret.) Veteran, 4th Marine Raiders | 21st Marines, 3rd Marine Division P.S.** When I was sixteen, I had to lie about my age to fight for my country. Now, at one hundred, I can tell you the truth as plain as I know it: freedom isn't free, and the stories of those who fought for it are fading fast. Your gift -- whatever you can give -- helps make sure they're never forgotten. The mission of the American Veterans Center and the World War II Veterans Committee is to preserve and promote the legacy and experiences of America's veterans and active duty service personnel from World War II through today. A non-profit educational organization, the AVC and WWIIVC are funded solely through generous contributions from people like you. All contributions are tax-deductible. Another
Trump judicial nominee has been confirmed to a lifetime seat on the bench.

Alexander Van Hook, like every single Trump nominee, refused to answer
basic questions about reality.

When asked who won the 2020 election (and explicitly told the question was
not about certification), Van Hook dodged, saying “Congress certified Joe
Biden as the winner.”

When pressed further, he stonewalled.

When asked about January 6 — one of the most violent attacks on our
democracy in modern history — Van Hook repeatedly responded with, “I
cannot provide an answer.”

If someone can’t acknowledge basic, indisputable facts, how can they
possibly be trusted to fairly interpret the law or uphold the
Constitution?

Trump’s nominees are disqualifying themselves by failing to acknowledge
basic facts, dodging accountability, and refusing to condemn an
insurrection. They hide behind crafted non-answers and avoid admitting
reality.

Yet Senate Democrats continue to vote yes. This is not normal — and it
will only stop if they face real political pressure.

We’re done watching this happen. Demand Justice is mobilizing public
pressure, accountability campaigns, and grassroots action to force Senate
Democrats to stop confirming judges who refuse to uphold democracy and the
rule of law. But we need all the support we can get to make this possible.

name: David Hogg
subject: My decision
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
My plans on running for office.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260108-1&t=1&akid=3025%2E587540%2EeqhB12)
Peter,
I was recently asked in an interview if I was planning to run for office.
My answer? **Hell, no.**
The idea for Leaders We Deserve started back in 2022 when now Congressman Maxwell Frost was first running for office and I came on board to help him raise money. He was a young candidate, driving Uber at night so he could afford to spend his days campaigning and talking to voters. He didn’t have the resources or family wealth connections that were practically required if you wanted to run a serious campaign. I didn’t have family wealth either, but I had a network (including donors like you, who I didn’t know personally but who were aware of my work on gun safety and could give Maxwell $10) and knew I could help him fundraise and win his race. As you know, he beat all the odds to win his election and become the first Gen-Z member of Congress.
So, yeah I could run for office and, if elected, join Rep. Frost as one of only two Gen-Z members of Congress. But here’s the reality: I think constantly about how to strengthen the progressive movement and advance gun safety so we can prevent the next Parkland from ever happening. If I ran for office and won, nearly everything I care about would be blocked by the filibuster. I would be just one vote at best, while Republicans would raise millions by fear-mongering about me “taking people’s guns.” Rather than pouring enormous resources into my own campaign to become a single vote, my efforts are far better spent helping elect exceptional young leaders across the country so that no matter what, the work continues.
That is why I know I can make a much bigger difference through our work at Leaders We Deserve, where we’re helping elect _dozens_ of incredibly talented young leaders every year. Young leaders all across the country who will give hope to a generation that has been ignored, who will combat gun violence and the climate crisis, and who will energize the Democratic party and turn us back into a winning coalition in 2026 and beyond.
I also know that this movement goes far beyond the impact any one person can have. We are not building a cult of personality at Leaders We Deserve, we’re building a lasting movement that is ushering the next generation of leaders into power. If something were to happen to me, this work would continue — and the bench of progressive champions we’re supporting would keep on fighting for our future.
My focus is _100%_ on electing the leaders who will transform the Democratic Party into the force it should be. But I need your help to do that. With the support of people who give $5, $10, $20 we can give our candidates something rare: the independence to represent their constituents instead of special interests. And with your help we are also giving a generation something we have not had for most of our lives: the hope that just maybe the best is still yet to come for America. Hope that while the system is broken there are actually a few good younger people who are fighting for the right thing.
**[Peter, can I count on you to make a $5 contribution to power our work?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260108_1_decision.7L2SnD&refcode=em20260108-3025&amount=5&t=2&akid=3025%2E587540%2EeqhB12)**

Thank you for your support,
David Hogg

subject: NEW: The Senate advanced my legislation to block war in Venezuela without congressional approval
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Kaine for Virginia
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-cgp-2026]
Derek , very big news out of the Senate today:
In a bipartisan vote, my legislation to direct the removal of U.S. hostilities within or against Venezuela that have not been authorized by Congress was advanced to the next step towards passage.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/0ZjehY4qIkWay7G_KqpLOw2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/0ZjehY4qIkWay7G_KqpLOw2]
This is a win in our fight to combat President Trump’s most reckless and dangerous abuses of power.
Let me be very clear: I do not challenge, nor does my War Powers Resolution challenge, the execution of a valid arrest warrant against Nicolas Maduro. Arresting Maduro and bringing him to justice in the United States will be good for America and good for Venezuela.
But the President’s claim that the U.S. will run Venezuela for years makes it clear that his plans go way beyond Maduro.
That means Congress needs a say — and that’s what my War Powers Resolution is about. If you agree we shouldn’t go to war without a debate and vote by Congress, add your name here to support my legislation now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/0ZjehY4qIkWay7G_KqpLOw2]
Already more than 200 people have been killed. U.S. troops have been injured. Two are still hospitalized. And it’s been made clear this will go on for a long period of time —the seizure of oil will go on, and the demands of terms about elections and the politics of Venezuela will go on.
But going forward, U.S. troops should not be used in hostilities in Venezuela without a vote of Congress — as the Constitution requires .
Another thing I want to make abundantly clear is that this legislation does not in itself say we can’t go to war with Venezuela. What it says is that Trump can’t unilaterally do that without the constitutionally-mandated approval of Congress.
Congress passes thousands of votes, even in a single term of the Senate, and there will inevitably be things that we look back on and say to ourselves, maybe we should have done this differently . The most likely vote to bring about such regret is a vote on matters of war.
But here is something I can guarantee you: No one has ever regretted a vote that just says, “Mr. President, before you send our sons and daughters to war, come to Congress.”
That is a vote that no one has ever regretted, and no one will ever regret.
So to my Senate colleagues, I say this: enough is enough. You were sent here to stand up for your constituents with courage and conviction. That means no war without a debate and vote in Congress.
When my War Powers Resolution continues to advance toward a final passage vote next week, I urge every one of my fellow Senators in the strongest possible terms to show that courage and do what is right.
Until then, I’m asking for your help in this. A groundswell of public support can have a significant impact on what happens here in Congress. So before the Senate votes on this legislation to block illegal war, will you add your name to support it?
Click here to sign on in support of my War Powers Resolution. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/0ZjehY4qIkWay7G_KqpLOw2]
SIGN THE PETITION [https://secure.ngpvan.com/0ZjehY4qIkWay7G_KqpLOw2]
Thank you for reading and for speaking out on this critical issue.
—Tim Kaine

subject: Today’s vote on health care subsidies is just the beginning
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Today the House of Representatives just passed an extension of the health care subsidies that Republicans allowed to expire at the start of this year.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260108-5793-footer&t=1&akid=5793%2E420207%2EPTRE3n)
Peter,
Today the House of Representatives just passed an extension of the health care subsidies that Republicans allowed to expire at the start of this year. This is an important step in ensuring that millions can still access health care in the short term, but make no mistake:
**Our fight to create a truly universal health care system is far from over.**
Even before these subsidies expired, millions were struggling to afford care, or went without coverage entirely, because greedy private insurance companies and Republicans have collapsed any semblance of a real health care system. When families are paying $20,000 just for insurance, before they even get health care, they simply can’t afford it.
That’s why it’s critical that we keep up the fight to build a new, universal system where people can actually afford care: Medicare For All.
According to a recent poll that my campaign commissioned, 90% of Democrats, most Independents, and 1/5 of Republicans support Medicare For All, a system where the government provides your insurance card — from birth to death, with comprehensive care.
Medicare For All is the only universal plan in Congress, and it already has so much support across the country. It will be a defining issue in the midterms, and even in battleground districts, a strong majority of voters — Democrats, independents, and Republicans — back Medicare For All.
**While we pressure the Senate to pass the bill that cleared the House today, we must also embrace Medicare For All as the real health care solution for families struggling to afford to live.**
[**If you agree, will you pitch in $3 to support my work for Medicare For All and help me keep up the fight?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20260108.FIJm5q&refcode=em20260108-5793&amount=3&t=2&akid=5793%2E420207%2EPTRE3n)

More and more Members of Congress are coming on to my Medicare For All bill, with 6 new members signing on recently. But we need to keep going. Together, we can build this movement into an unstoppable political force and get it done.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

**To every American who cares about our fight to end gun violence, please don’t skip this email. Gabby Giffords has a message for you.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/22617?c0=giffords-em-q12026-jan8.4aulmG&refcode=em260108-3-EX&t=1&akid=11161%2E3935704%2ERNnvrd)
Today marks 15 years since a gunman tried to assassinate Gabby. As the nation’s eyes were upon her, she embarked on a path to regain her ability to speak and walk, inspiring millions across the country with her resilient spirit.
Hear more about her story — in her own words.
[**Click here to watch Gabby’s video. If there’s one thing you watch today, please let it be this.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/22617?c0=giffords-em-q12026-jan8.4aulmG&refcode=em260108-3-EX&t=2&akid=11161%2E3935704%2ERNnvrd)
**[WATCH THE VIDEO](https://go.giffords.org/go/22617?c0=giffords-em-q12026-jan8.4aulmG&refcode=em260108-3-EX&t=3&akid=11161%2E3935704%2ERNnvrd)**
Thank you for watching,
Team GIFFORDS

**👋 Wait, before you click away... 🛑**
As a victim of political violence, Gabby Giffords has led the fight to save lives from gun violence for more than a decade...but she can’t do it alone.
If everyone reading this donated just $17, we'd have the resources to take on the gun lobby. But not everyone gives — making it even more critical that people who understand the stakes of our struggle to pitch in.
Please make a donation of $17 to GIFFORDS PAC. Some people give more — others less — but what matters most is that you are joining Gabby in the fight. Especially today.
**[DONATE TODAY](https://go.giffords.org/go/63973?c0=giffords-em-q12026-jan8._-x51i&refcode=em260108-3-EX&t=4&akid=11161%2E3935704%2ERNnvrd)**

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=5&akid=11161%2E3935704%2ERNnvrd) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

You swear an oath to the Constitution when you join the military — including the First Amendment right to free speech. We swore to defend the foundational principles of this country. I took that oath seriously 40 years ago, and I still do.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122938891/593951685/-2000534896?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.01.08_Mark-Kelly-Split_B2_F1_S1_C1_90OP-NC_RS-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkNzZjMWZlYi1mMWVjLWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7sQ7JmaH6f0VEOpzkLYQvvTsmDiC6wKVdSNi10mj3EU=) Team:

Pete Hegseth decided he's going to censure me, and is threatening to demote me and reduce my pension.

I got shot at in service to this country. I missed holidays and birthdays. I commanded a space shuttle mission and launched to the International Space Station while my wife recovered from a gunshot wound to the head.

My rank and retirement are things that I earned through my service and sacrifice for this country. Generations of servicemembers have done the same. Pete Hegseth wants to send a message to every single one that he will come after them if they say something he doesn’t like.

You swear an oath to the Constitution when you join the military — including the First Amendment right to free speech. We swore to defend the foundational principles of this country. I took that oath seriously 40 years ago, and I still do.

Pete Hegseth can threaten to reduce my rank and my pension. But I am not going to let him intimidate me, or anyone else. He is not going to stop me from defending our democracy from a president who is hellbent on destroying it.

If they think this is going to shut me up, they’ve got another thing coming.

Republicans are holding the House by a very small margin. Everyone in Washington knows it. **Democrats are already counting seats and making plans for what they’ll do if they take control back in 2026.**

clean_body: It wasn’t about politics — it was about peace| | | | | Fellow Patriot, | | Charlie Kirk built a movement for truth -- but his final message pointed to something eternal. It wasn't about politics... or elections... or even about the culture war. His final book was deeply personal, and unlike anything Charlie had written before... It was about the Sabbath. About sacred rest. Reconnecting with God. Charlie wrote this book because he knew what America was missing... and what he nearly lost himself. He found that in a world addicted to busyness, noise, and scrolling... The most radical act of resistance is to STOP. To rest. To reflect. To return to God. This book is his blueprint for how we do that -- as individuals, as families, and as a nation. 🔥 You'll discover how Charlie learned to honor the Sabbath in a culture that never stops 🔥 How setting aside just one day a week gave him clarity, peace, and strength 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark a spiritual revival across America I know he would've wanted you to have this book. When you give today to Turning Point USA, you 're not just supporting the movement Charlie built -- you're helping pass on the message he felt most urgently in his final months. Fellow Patriot, thank you, in advance, for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage -- the very things Charlie gave his life for. And as you do, may the message of this book lead you -- just as it led Charlie -- to a deeper trust in God, a stronger love for your family, and a renewed peace in your own soul. For Charlie, Justin Streiff Chief Operating Officer Turning Point USA P.S. subject: Fatal ICE confrontation in Minneapolis — Walz called it "patriotic duty"
body:
Plus: Same agent was attacked six months ago. It just happened again. | New for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=527ee6a660&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | |
A woman is dead in Minneapolis after a confrontation with ICE agents. You're going to hear a lot of different versions of what happened. [We have photos that tell the real story — frame by frame. ](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=badca7abc6&e=567664f14c)When you see where the agents were standing, where she was, and what happened next, you'll understand why this isn't what the media is making it out to be.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d384ddae72&e=567664f14c)
| |
🚨 **THE AGENT'S BACKSTORY — THIS CHANGES EVERYTHING**
The agent who fired? Six months ago, he was dragged by a vehicle during another ICE confrontation. He survived that one. Now look at these photos. See where he's standing — directly in front of her driver's side. She accelerates. He has a split second to decide. We walk through each frame. When you see it laid out, you'll understand why this agent is not going to face charges — and why the people calling this "murder" have no idea what they're talking about.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=355d733877&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🎭 **THEN MAYOR FREY OPENED HIS MOUTH**
Hours after this woman died, Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey held a press conference. He didn't call for calm. He didn't ask people to stay safe. He didn't say "let's get the facts first." He cursed at federal agents and told them to get out of his city.
We play the clip. Mark calls him a "theater kid" who got someone killed. You'll see why.

📢 **WALZ SAID THIS WAS "PATRIOTIC"**
Governor Tim Walz is on record calling protesting ICE "a patriotic duty."
The city of Minneapolis put out a statement blaming ICE for "causing chaos" — while a woman lay dead after confronting them. Three of the four vehicle attacks on federal agents have happened in Minneapolis. Not spread across the country. Same city. Same leadership. Same rhetoric.
We connect the dots.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=02c270b3c7&e=567664f14c)
---
| |
🇻🇪 **VENEZUELA — THE BUSINESS TAKEOVER**
Quick hit: The US is now controlling Venezuela's oil revenue and directing it to benefit the people instead of corrupt leaders. We play a Scott Jennings clip that's already going viral — his take on why 42% of Americans oppose literally everything Trump does. And Fetterman is still the only Democrat willing to say this was a win.

🇬🇱 **GREENLAND — 43% CHANCE**
The White House confirmed purchase discussions are "actively being discussed." Betting markets have it at 43%. Trump is treating foreign policy like a business acquisition. Venezuela. Now Greenland. We break down what's actually happening and what could be next.

🏠 **TWO WINS — IF POLITICIANS WILL TAKE THEM**
Trump announced he's banning institutional investors from buying single family homes. "People live in homes, not corporations." This one should be bipartisan. We'll see. And there's a new federal school choice tax credit — $1,700 dollar-for-dollar, scholarships worth $10,000+ for kids. Colorado's Democratic governor already opted in. Will New Mexico? If MLG says no, that money goes to other states. **We explain why this is a no-brainer — and why she still might not do it.**

Fellow Patriot,

My name is **Corporal Frank S. Wright** , United States Marine Corps, retired. I'm a hundred years old now -- one of the last living Marine Raiders of World War II.In January 1942, just weeks after the attack on Pearl Harbor, I quit high school in Arkansas and walked into the enlistment office. I was sixteen -- too young, too skinny, and too light to qualify. The sergeant told me to come back when I was heavier.So I went home, ate all the bananas I could find, and stuffed five pounds' worth into my pockets before stepping on that scale again.I passed. I lied about my age. And I became a Marine.

After boot camp, I volunteered to join the **4th Marine Raiders** , America's first special operations unit.They asked me why I wanted to join. I said, _" Because I want to fight."_Our commanding officer was **James Roosevelt** , the President's son -- a good man, the kind who never gave an order he wouldn't do himself. We were trained to land first, fight behind enemy lines, and take the beaches nobody else could reach.From **Guadalcanal** to **New Georgia** , from the jungles of the Solomons to the black sand of **Iwo Jima** , we fought to free the Pacific.On **Guam** , I was stabbed in the stomach during hand-to-hand combat. On **Iwo Jima** , I was hit by machine-gun fire and knocked unconscious. Both times, my men thought I was gone. Somehow, I wasn't.When I came to, I saw the flag rising on Mount Suribachi. Every ship in the harbor sounded its horn. I had tears in my eyes then, and I still do when I think about it.That flag meant freedom still lived.

There were dark days too...On Guadalcanal, I caught malaria and ended up in a field hospital -- but when my unit was preparing to move out, I couldn't stand being left behind.I slipped out and rejoined them. I'll now admit, I was always a little rebellious. When the war ended, I became a drill instructor, helping shape the next generation of Marines. I was in my twenties, carrying wounds inside and out.For more than a decade, I didn't share my stories. I kept them locked away, like many of my brothers did. Over the years, I began to open up and share my story with friends, family, and others who wanted to know about the realities of the battlefield at the Pacific Front.Now, more than ever, the **American Veterans Center** has given me the opportunity to share them -- on the stage at the **Annual Conference** , and by capturing them on film for future generations. Not just my story, but those of the men who never came home, and those who are no longer here to tell theirs.

clean_body: I carry the scars — and the duty to remember. I still remember seeing the flag raised on Iwo Jima... | | | Fellow Patriot, My name is Corporal Frank S. Wright , United States Marine Corps, retired. I'm a hundred years old now -- one of the last living Marine Raiders of World War II.In January 1942, just weeks after the attack on Pearl Harbor, I quit high school in Arkansas and walked into the enlistment office. I was sixteen -- too young, too skinny, and too light to qualify. The sergeant told me to come back when I was heavier.So I went home, ate all the bananas I could find, and stuffed five pounds' worth into my pockets before stepping on that scale again.I passed. I lied about my age. And I became a Marine. After boot camp, I volunteered to join the 4th Marine Raiders , America's first special operations unit.They asked me why I wanted to join. I said, " Because I want to fight."Our commanding officer was James Roosevelt , the President's son -- a good man, the kind who never gave an order he wouldn't do himself. We were trained to land first, fight behind enemy lines, and take the beaches nobody else could reach.From Guadalcanal to New Georgia , from the jungles of the Solomons to the black sand of Iwo Jima , we fought to free the Pacific.On Guam , I was stabbed in the stomach during hand-to-hand combat. On Iwo Jima , I was hit by machine-gun fire and knocked unconscious. Both times, my men thought I was gone. Somehow, I wasn't.When I came to, I saw the flag rising on Mount Suribachi. Every ship in the harbor sounded its horn. I had tears in my eyes then, and I still do when I think about it.That flag meant freedom still lived. There were dark days too...On Guadalcanal, I caught malaria and ended up in a field hospital -- but when my unit was preparing to move out, I couldn't stand being left behind.I slipped out and rejoined them. I'll now admit, I was always a little rebellious. When the war ended, I became a drill instructor, helping shape the next generation of Marines. I was in my twenties, carrying wounds inside and out.For more than a decade, I didn't share my stories. I kept them locked away, like many of my brothers did. Over the years, I began to open up and share my story with friends, family, and others who wanted to know about the realities of the battlefield at the Pacific Front.Now, more than ever, the American Veterans Center has given me the opportunity to share them -- on the stage at the Annual Conference , and by capturing them on film for future generations. Not just my story, but those of the men who never came home, and those who are no longer here to tell theirs. They've given old Marines like me a place to share what we lived through, to look young cadets and future service members in the eye and say, "This is what it means to serve."They've brought veterans from every generation together -- to remember, to teach, and to inspire. And every year, the American Veterans Center Annual Conference gives us something rare -- a gathering where history stands shoulder to shoulder with the future.It's where I've met cadets who listen with the same wide eyes I once had at sixteen. It's where old comrades find each other again, and where we all remember that the values we fought for -- courage, duty, honor -- are still being carried forward.It's a living bridge between those who fought for freedom and those who will defend it next. The National Memorial Day Parade in Washington, D.C., where America gathers to honor its heroes. The Annual Veterans Conference each November, where we share stories and pass the torch to those who will serve next. The preservation of our stories through documentaries and oral histories -- so that when we are gone, the lessons remain. At my age, I don't take many things for granted. But I still believe in this country -- in what it stands for, and in the people who keep its history alive.If you believe that too, I ask you to help the American Veterans Center continue its work. So that long after the last of us is gone, our voices will still be heard -- reminders of what America can be when its people stand together.Thank you for remembering. Thank you for caring. And thank you for keeping faith with those who served.Semper Fidelis, Frank S. Wright Corporal, U.S. Marine Corps (Ret.) name: GOP Presidential
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations

Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom.
| | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjgnh0kvbshlimghqefpj493jmfvltqmst4ehg6g_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjim6ob2c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zoq0fi5ss6552d4rmkshodm3j2293mm735mr4ok8_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjim6ob2c3h2bs)
---
| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z44rtl2loiti6vc6fvs7kkl7f0d3aa26ua1ol66g_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjim6ob2c3h2bs)**[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zqijr6qpkpmr6hmit20b2oqj6holt7k1qrr5qf2g_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjim6ob2c3h2bs), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers--one from each scholar--written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. **[Simply click here to request your free copy of _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z4dhhjornsm52e2aagrtk7g2g9a14qplbs83rumg_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjim6ob2c3h2bs)** Thanks,Greg Greg Stamps | Online DevelopmentHoover Institution | Stanford University
---

Over more than one hundred years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world._

body:
Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love.

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zss3bh2hugps80bu2m6ie860dth0lb2gnigrl42o_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjim6ob6c3h2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zt0up7ekvfto3h3hf93quph7ok4beue09e5s6ju0_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjim6ob6c3h2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. ## Senate Moves to Block Trump in Venezuela
The Senate voted 52-47 on Thursday to advance a War Powers resolution barring President Trump from [further military action in Venezuela](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAUhJ_GdEa28fJTuEhDt2lTogM-Xpz4B5kDaPP0V-x9hNuMRhrp08z8eU5P8MGn12-IaMjlKeG1ByTCMu2YgHA-ln87lSNu0aeEsOUwKaFaLiQXw2TBh_ekK2scosKmQiO7thseba9VtRprwWlpXYeD7R8a9OCaAVvpHDy0nFXlzU0TUgxSik6pepi7xYJrG5AoemyZFmg95VL_zT7Rii6884mlXnKsglmJtp01v5gamRqv66qXNC93yNR4o5kahbylZ2o8MeH_AwPw73X8zOTTi-fEVwgfG33wBOXNYSGfEwdHWHgEe5TMF9joKFivFENVjN0uH4Lf245p8Yrgw6cV_ejK06ivAAAA___g1Yp3) after a U.S. strike captured leader Nicolás Maduro. Sponsored by Sen. Tim Kaine, D-Va., and co-sponsored by Rand Paul, R-Ky., the vote on the resolution was procedural but indicated that the measure, which would force Trump to seek congressional approval before any new use of force, has enough support to pass. Five Republicans joined Democrats—Paul, Susan Collins, Lisa Murkowski, Josh Hawley, and Todd Young—[in a rare GOP break](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2y2yAUhJ9G6tDAEQaroEijzmlTajAcZBL-BrAV36e_I7_CrXf2m_32z227aR982n_riKq7vCU8WsDesW4Nk-54f5p_rddnLNGnhLrksAEFQSgjdNms9uG98dEqhwg4j6iYFHK5iCuH8aFQyNlRxjUHs6ADye1lFkZYZ0AsTI9enTTK6MIYlQDTcpfGaidmzZBeUQycovU91-lv9qk_0IV3fmGdTI5jUI_eSxvmXwOsA6zHcUwu_z8tznyAteTguzdtgHXPhXykcm3khBGLMZuqeyOt50I-msTVHMlZMz7t5IUJv54Y9FiVLYcPwTchB073qH34jOg_eu6l4DsAAP__KBaGuA) from Trump, saying bombing and leadership removal are acts of war reserved for Congress. Trump blasted [the five GOP senators](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGK5CAQhp_G3AymkjbJwUMvS269LOzCHIPRSrczRkVNpPvph_QrzK2g4OP_vo_bfJPGGnf_IzcUefWzw5Is5oxxTuhkxmVXXynHfQubcQ5l8HYGBpyyhrJx1tLY59xVWqyIgG2Foul5P1740EH1EIovatVrO8h-0d3SQ6v5uIIeB8bVBZfKiJPGGjY2DesB6nHplZYrb2WDbEBOOobaZB_rT29cfuBqn_7AWCu_VVY8cg6JtFcCE4GplFJvyZ0_AhM6uicC0ylFYAremmzUeb6FaLJyS_TuA327-pjoSaYHOnztaCUtMtLgC8ZED5-RwCQjvV6b_3-zeZF28spo0v7-dSbEkv5hDFUUOhRjrUm8Jx27b9LY99j8o8KHgO8AAAD___swk8E) in a Truth Social post, saying they “should never be elected to office again.”
## Medical Problem Ends NASA Mission
NASA is [cutting short](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL3O4yAURJ_G7hxdsPkrKLZJl223tK7hkrDBgAxJlLdfeV_hK0cjzeicP7f1hjHFfP-NO9keyprp0xL1TsfaKGOn7eWerR-vve4xZ8Ja0sqBywnYBGb1GNN3XUZvAxGneSTLlFRGSL3w8WENLvPsyAsHIL2AhW0azKadc4qH4MZozzVgYBgDxfnFbMp5DHJGRqBJDguQj70cl78l5v6gkL7lTcfFlX1M9tF7bcP8a-DXgV-xngBndYajR5do4NeMDadW0dEH03OqpfVaMvmJoQzKLDCLjbQUmgMXjhkZdDCkNjEe1tdPTCk2qYYF7jvG9P-5_0jX2_J_AQAA__-mF34e) the Crew-11 mission from the International Space Station after an astronaut developed a medical problem, prompting the agency to postpone the first spacewalk of 2026. The space agency said on Thursday that the U.S.-Japanese-Russian crew of four [will return to Earth](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMHOnCAURp8Gdxi4OKALFk0ad9NN03RprnKduS2CEZyJb99MX-Fff8mXc87v-3RHjpweP3AjX9c8JXqXSLXSMRVKWGk-l7-lHue2b5wS4Z7jBAqsVFqqYQrI8Zq6JviVCMg05LWzbrjZvoPm6bWDoUNreuPCrG566GEhWklDH7p1dg37z5vSatBaOYB2mN0ScLUGNamerOgUBa75aP9kTvVJa7zyi452yVsT_bPWvQjzTcAoYMR5-Ri0j_yZBYy_fgoYExaUlILkUuTGpXBOkvCIlwwnyY0CLxhl4Xpi5ZwEjKXm4xJm5CDMdw2D0lZ1pjl82N8cIxfrRKceG3L8D1K_VO_l4V8AAAD__x4Og9M) in the coming days, a month earlier than planned. The crew included NASA’s Zena Cardman and Mike Fincke, along with Japan’s Kimiya Yui and Russia’s Oleg Platonov. The medical issue emerged on Wednesday afternoon, and NASA said the astronaut involved is currently stable. The identity and condition weren't disclosed for privacy reasons.
## List: Best Waffle Cafe in Every State
A list of the [best waffle restaurants](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuniAcR58GNwyglevA0MXtdu1oQH580iIY-H8a3765fYW7n5yTnN-f66eNKebXL3vAUChrxt0SiFDXhmwJ7r39bVTfx3nEnGHPklYl1MSF5GJevY3pWcfOmwAoDB2M1JOef0wfo-p2s2lgdsoFWOf95vTo5iAC3CAkRrV10XzZhBSzlEIr1c9Ob96GabAS4gMTGwV8pFL7PyVm2hHSUy7UfitHl8xOdDY2_GRqYWq577tP5UIoxX8BTC0vmxLqk2IjphYphknPTC20gzs04rcNIYFXNLLvajPxmDku1Ic3soSuGn_eMaXYJs1G8TpsTP_j9K1jl1H_AgAA__9ytYMU) in each state shows that Americans love waffles whether piled high with berries or drenched in syrup with a side of fried chicken. The list ranges from the simple waffle at [Le Peep in Nebraska](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykjz1vwjAQQH9NvIHO52CTwUOXbHTtaB32hbj1lxID4t9X9C90fnpPel8Xd6GYYrl9Umbbl-oKP_fEvfPmdi7U-Xr3P3vf7rnlWApTq8khoD6APMDkAsX0cqMIdmFGVoKtNNpMJ30eUazWn8gHExiBlCLptVEwcgCz4GlSCkS07xpImKQEg3icrsYHWrQiyXBmPYzAIfa6Hb9rLH3lJb3qg7ejr1kku_be9kF9DDgPOCduzK1mWunNB5zFZkN7xpTirs0wwi1TTH9u_9fww-JvAAAA___ymGob) to the “Fly Ball” at the Copper Dog Cafe in North Dakota, a pepperoni-and-cheese pizza waffle with pizza sauce. More than 10 restaurants serve fried chicken with their waffles. Some places, like [Yo’ Mama’s in downtown Birmingham](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykz79uwyAQgPGnsbdYcHYgHhi6ZEvXjuiMj4SWPxZcYvntq_QVun_6Sd_Xzd4wxJDvn5jIsC82094iMVO1jTIyLU_307g-05ZCzoRbiRYEqJOQJzHbFUM87NSvxhMBjT0ZqZWez-oyQf8wXoBS_owS4QILjVo6Dw7HeTrrBcj1wbw1IcUspdAAw7xot6JXI0oSF1LdJGgNXOrwXULmB_l4lBfVwZXUR_Ng3lo3fnRw7eC67_twlIQJW6XG-KyY-V12cO2rWbc9xBia0t0k7glD_FP4X-svA78BAAD__51hbqY), Alabama, serve the chicken on the side, while others, following the example of Dame’s in North Carolina, place the chicken directly on top of the waffle. Still others, like Oklahoma’s Waffle Champion and Texas’ Seabrook Waffle Company, elevate the waffle to brunch status by stacking savory items like eggs, bacon, ham, chicken, and a dash of Tabasco honey. [See the best waffle restaurant in your state here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGuniAcR58GNwyglevA0MXtdu1oQH580iIY-H8a3765fYW7n5yTnN-f66eNKebXL3vAUChrxt0SiFDXhmwJ7r39bVTfx3nEnGHPklYl1MSF5GJevY3pWcfOmwAoDB2M1JOef0wfo-p2s2lgdsoFWOf95vTo5iAC3CAkRrV10XzZhBSzlEIr1c9Ob96GabAS4gMTGwV8pFL7PyVm2hHSUy7UfitHl8xOdDY2_GRqYWq577tP5UIoxX8BTC0vmxLqk2IjphYphknPTC20gzs04rcNIYFXNLLvajPxmDku1Ic3soSuGn_eMaXYJs1G8TpsTP_j9K1jl1H_AgAA__9ytYMU).

# [This Is What Weaponized Outrage Looks Like](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3159258&post_id=183965266&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTgzOTY1MjY2LCJpYXQiOjE3Njc5NjA4NDEsImV4cCI6MTc3MDU1Mjg0MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTMxNTkyNTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.6-uYbvGJHSLQtibRS3kSMVebgIMeCUygoKrhStV3MM0)
### How bots, algorithms, and tragedy collide
| | [The Angry Democrat](https://substack.com/@theangrydem)

| Jan 9
---

---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3159258&post_id=183965266&utm_source=substack&isFreemail=true&submitLike=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTgzOTY1MjY2LCJyZWFjdGlvbiI6IuKdpCIsImlhdCI6MTc2Nzk2MDg0MSwiZXhwIjoxNzcwNTUyODQxLCJpc3MiOiJwdWItMzE1OTI1OCIsInN1YiI6InJlYWN0aW9uIn0.t5mkCxy9_ko2fXLFcI59IVY23ugdiCwFBN376fGRuOo&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=email-reaction&r=1hvr60)

| | [](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3159258&post_id=183965266&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTgzOTY1MjY2LCJpYXQiOjE3Njc5NjA4NDEsImV4cCI6MTc3MDU1Mjg0MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTMxNTkyNTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.6-uYbvGJHSLQtibRS3kSMVebgIMeCUygoKrhStV3MM0)

In the wake of what happened in Minneapolis, I tried to figure out how I could add something to the conversation that hasn't already been said.
Everybody has a take. The left. The right. Social media. Substack. Newsletters. YouTube. TikTok. Everyone rushing out their two cents.
I'll leave that to them.
The only thing I keep noticing, over and over again, every time there is tragedy, is the absolute dehumanizing language. From both sides.
That's the part that I can't ignore.
* * *
## Charlie Kirk and the Collapse of Humanity Online
When **Charlie Kirk** was murdered/assassinated, many of us watched it unfold in real time. A shot through the neck. Live. Unfiltered.
And almost immediately, the internet went to work.
His politics were stripped from context and turned into justification. His speech was flattened into a caricature. His life was reduced to a lesson.
What was completely ignored was that he was a father. That he left behind two kids who now don't have one.
Watching people on the left talk about how he "incited violence" and therefore somehow deserved what happened to him was absolutely fucking disgusting.
I remember stepping in and asking a very simple question:
Does anybody deserve to be assassinated for speech?
Political speech carries risk. Influence carries responsibility. None of that makes murder justifiable. None of it.
At the end of the day, two kids lost their father. That should matter.
* * *
## Rob Reiner, His Wife, and the Cruelty of Reduction
Then there was **Rob Reiner and his wife** , murdered in their own home by their son.
A son who reportedly had a long history of mental health struggles.
Think about what that actually means. A lifetime of pain. Of parental love. Of trying. Of doubt. Of fear. Of devotion. Of things we will never see on a timeline.
And how did this tragedy get treated?
The President of the United States tweeted about it as "Trump Derangement Syndrome."
That's it. That was the frame.
A family annihilated. A mental health crisis decades in the making. Reduced to a punchline.
That should horrify you, regardless of your politics.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/94218a55-bb7c-44f6-8f72-070ca5246e15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
## Minneapolis and "FAFO"
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3e4cc999-9918-486d-8fb6-3b66036f4fa3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now we get to Minneapolis.
A woman. Thirty-seven years old. A mother of three. Shot and killed.
And what do I see flooding the internet?
"FAFO."
"Fuck around and find out."
"Play stupid games, win stupid prizes."
Totally dehumanizing.
Regardless of her politics. Regardless of what people _think_ they know about the situation.
Three kids lost their mother.
Sit with that for a second.
If your first instinct is to reach for a slogan instead of empathy, something is wrong.
* * *
## Number One: We Have to Be Smarter
These are our peers saying crazy stuff. And the people on the other side of the aisle are still people.
It is on _you_ to check the language of the people around you.
Don't just play the game.
Don't just repeat the phrase you heard your friend say.
Don't turn off your brain and go with the crowd.
It is okay to say, "Hey, take a step back."
It is okay to say, "She was a mother with three kids."
It is okay to say, "That fucking sucks for those kids."
That doesn't make you weak. It makes you human.
* * *
## Number Two: We Are Being Played
Here's the part people really don't want to deal with.
We are being baited.
Earlier this year, **Charles Hoskinson** , the founder of Cardano, got pulled into a debate with what turned out to be an online bot (Roastmaster 9000). It was notable because he is considered a very smart guy that is also a programer.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f5977a47-0f19-499e-867f-20592de9d6c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The bot said just the right unhinged things. It triggered him. It dragged him into engagement.
That's not an accident. That's how the system works.
There are engagement farms all over the world. The Philippines. Vietnam. India. Nigeria. Ethiopia. Rows and rows of phones whose only job is to engage online.
You can buy engagement.
You can buy outrage.
You can buy narrative shaping.
For business.
For personal brands.
For advertising.
And yes, for political influence.
What I see online is this: it starts with bots and ends with real people. People who submit their morality to the last thing they saw. People who let the bot mob do their thinking for them.
Don't fall for it.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d239ed16-8d2b-4562-8d6d-563997fb4c38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/b040f770-6098-4f2f-b55d-979fd6bfca65?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
## Number Three: This Is Propaganda
All of this is propaganda.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3568fa76-6a61-4ffc-ae46-d95c0be00af4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Our devices have been weaponized.
The screens in our living rooms.
The phones in our pockets.
The dashboards in our cars.
Advertisers do it. Political actors do it. Media companies do it. Anyone with an agenda does it.
They hand you the narrative of the moment. They tell you what to think and how to speak.
Here's a simple exercise: after a tragedy, stay silent for one day.
Just listen.
Count how many times you hear the **same words** , the **same phrases** , the **same framing** repeated over and over again.
#### That's not organic. **That 's programming.**
Fast food.
Fast fashion.
Fast information.
Fast thought.
And now, fast morality.
* * *
## Just Stop for a Minute
Stop. Don't post. Don't engage.
See who actually says something original.
Because the moment you stop reacting on cue is the moment you become harder to manipulate.
**Stay angry.**
But don't let that anger turn you into someone who forgets that the people in these stories were human beings first.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. ## Beloved Museum Faces Relocation
The Panhandle Plains Historical Museum at West Texas A&M University in Canyon—home to the state's largest collection of historical artifacts—has been closed since last March after the Texas State Fire Marshal identified numerous code violations. Last month, university officials asked the museum to [relocate](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO3DAMRU8jdxpQnLFsFS7SuNu0KQ2ORK-FyJIhcdcztw-cHCENC4J8-P_9-lg-KKaYP3_SzpO81rJkPltiEa7L_tX4a5etMglnDlKKbAc1WRDQajAa3BIopvfy6ML0hOBMx5MZ7OAsgDXdNt1xdD54_xyIR3sfnr3raewH9M-eGNYuThcMDDiDAP14643Dkbzz1q3EltUDOEQp9SYbC7-oreldvrnefNm7NG0iR1P3HwpnhfN5njfaqcaUynWgcG5S6lvhfDVTOCNgr3A2eA17vYhuzL-brpyKJ4kl6yNR1mup-qC8UQ6Jr1XMTW_x4kVPSf_zo3AehxEAzAgwKJy7OoXjjCnFZgf1gM-dYvobVv5P8feEfwIAAP__X36QYw) its collection, claiming they couldn't fund the needed repairs. ## Venezuelan Oil Coming to Texas Refineries
President Trump announced Tuesday that Venezuela would "immediately" [relinquish](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOozAQhJ8GOqO1AwQXLq6hy7VXIsdeh5WMjewlJPf0v5JX-OuRZub7_t2Wm6VI6fHXbmj4FfKS8KwRmbEs21Hx2HgtaBkTes6Z191WXhSoUYAUoBdvKb6XvvXmDl7LFo28jlc9AoyyXY1X4aLBhslPPahhGIa77MGFIYAHiVNL5lMGErRUAMPUDVKryTrtRh0sjtj0gJ44l45XZHzZGuI7P7F0Lm9tNCvzXpvLn0bNjZrP8-xCfn0oPnmj5j1HYnK1UfMTE_4_MNokMsUqCvJRknD5iF7QtlvH4rsgCgZKWAireNgq9kIOq0iWKaeTPLbF-P2kGKmO16aHx2Ypfg_x7zQ-jfoJAAD__2t5i90) up to 50 million barrels of sanctioned oil to the United States. The next day, Energy Secretary Chris Wright said the U.S. will "let the oil flow" from the South American country's vast reserves while [controlling sales](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2OqzAQhZ_GdKCxA_4pXNyGLrfdEk3wECwZjPAEkn36FfsK25zq0_l0ztd9uGNMcX3-x4U8v6c8rHSWRMy0D8ur0GvheSdkWilwzjxvWHhQoHQNsgY3BIzpM7RV8A8ITlbkpdHGaQAtq9mPVk8asFMTWm2gBSuD1VbL1hgXHqGK_ioDCU4qgM42nXTK4uhG7SYkTaIFCpHz3vBMTG8sU_rkg_ZmzEuV_My8FXH7J1QvVH-eZ7PlFDmO-QKE6q9FQvWXRqge5BXmQvf4nLk-aKXvFyVc6xxTXTBRqQGMvOmurXYftjOmFIs2ooXngjH9ivlvdx1e_QQAAP__vN59KQ) of the commodity. Texas refineries are [specially equipped](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGumzAURL8GdjeyXQJ4wSJSRVevq0pdIoOHYMnYke8lvLyvr9JfeOsZzRydvx_ThwsxpPtvt2OQzzVPCSdHiKBM-8E4dtkKnCDBS86yPRzLZJRpSWlSdvIuxNfU1H6Ylbe6xqC7trOtUq2ut6FfZq1N062msQ7o--5q-26-ao9ZY2nrMLzHlFZWG6Wu_eWqrendYpfWrg4tqkbBB8nlIhsEn47X-MpPlMuS9zoOm8iDqx-3yoyVGc_zvOyc3lllRiQ6uDLjnhNelRlDeoJlR5J3dXvRlg-WnIipYA0JJYBpyUf0NINkA83hfgcLnSElFKaQ6ImErwPREVPCSTlECskfLOV94grdbvrPT__1qy6Df5whxsBtVzXqvrsQ_3PL92w_B_MvAAD__98TmFQ) to process the sulfur-rich "sour" crude oil produced by Venezuelan oil fields. Currently, most of the heavy crude processed by these refineries is imported from Canada and the Middle East. Increased access to Venezuelan oil "would allow refiners to operate more efficiently," according to industry analyst Jaime Brito. U.S. imports of Venezuelan oil have dropped significantly since sanctions were imposed in 2017, and Houston-based Chevron is the only U.S. oil company authorized to operate in the country. President Trump is reportedly [meeting with major oil executives](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2O2zAQxfHTUB0NcmxRq0JFGnWbNqUwJscWA34YnKFl5_TBbpELpP4DDw-_X5_bJ8YUy_0nZlrkdatboYMTiVDbcmfqWfZGKFQoSK2yP5BlAwNOG6vNvAWM6b1dhrBcTZjtQIud3DQ7Y5wd9uXsLNkJz3AG78hNwV0xAFk_QvAjjENcvsaMNbMFY8aP02hn-EA_ezffkBypi6EQpbaT7CT0Qr6ld31SO_mah7TsIg9W5x8KVgXrcRynRl2o8VdXsF47x0LMClYq1O5vBau0nh8aQ44lsjSUWIvekXWpon0t3JNQ0J11jUln_F0ba7zWLvpJhf50Svid6EWe9T-OUcE6tCU8jphSZDepi7lnjOn7q_yf8HOBvwEAAP__0XqTTQ) to discuss investing billions in Venezuela's oil industry, aiming to boost production that has fallen by two-thirds since its peak in 1999.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Do you remember Avery Jackson? The “trans girl” who, at 9, was on the cover of National Geographic?

|
---
| | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z854o4qf5itqcoefuotpb4gmiit2mgq41f59fmeg_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjge0pr4cth2bs)
Friend,

Do you remember Avery Jackson? The “trans girl” who, at 9, was on the cover of National Geographic?

Now, at 19, Avery has said that transitioning “ruined [his] life.”

His childhood and his normalcy were stolen from him. The chemical castration he endured has stunted his mental and physical development in irreversible ways, leaving him unable to father a child.

I have a few dispositions that come naturally and seem at odds. One is a desire to understand and empathize with all people, even when they have wildly challenging points of view.

**And then there’s the protective dad mode.** When I detect the exploitation of innocence. This causes me to see red, breathe fire, and seek the destruction of villains.

**The extremes of this diabolical “trans” agenda exploit mental illness in our kids for a toxic mix of profit and satanic ideology. Yes, I’m using the word satanic. Because it’s evil. I oppose it with every fiber of my being. **

Our job as dads is to protect our boys from anti-Western, identity-obsessed, Marxist dogma so that they can become the kind of men this world has always needed: strong, loyal, stoic, driven.

**This is why I created Emergent Order Foundation – particularly Dad Saves America - for parents, for kids, and for the future.**

We share heroic stories that elevate virtue, celebrate freedom, and invite people into a fuller understanding of who they’re meant to be.

[Friend, I don’t want to come off too strong. However, we must save Western Civilization. I am hoping to bring on 50 new supporters to join me this month. Can you donate $10 or more to help us create pro-America media online?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg6lsrlr9r0gkjqf58bm9kb002pcg9fbahdhii2g_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjge0pr4cth2bs)

**How We’re Going to Save America**

Emergent Order Foundation is creating a new media ecosystem focused on aspirational, virtue-driven stories to inspire men to embrace their full potential.

Our country desperately needs independent voices that aren’t NPR, Disney, and other woke media companies.

As a non-profit organization, we are only concerned with serving our mission to be a clear, strong, trusted voice speaking out to save America and the West.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zmspecro0o6okmhj7k6jajoq4udp57ngmb85rl1g_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjge0pr4cth2bs)

**Dad Saves America**

Dad Saves America has over 450,000 subscribers and 44 million views! We’re creating a movement of dads and could-be dads who embrace our heroic calling to raise a new generation ready to thrive in a free society and be champions of Western Civilization.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zhdol7glm6ovd97prb0k0bo19mqed9h4ks8vt6c8_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjge0pr4cth2bs)
**The Censorship Files**

We teamed up with Michael Shellenberger to investigate the censorship industrial complex. It’s a major documentary project exposing how a hidden system of government and corporate censorship is reshaping American democracy.

Friend, Jesus wisely taught us, “Ask, and you shall receive!”

I am emailing you to ask for your immediate support for our work.

And as a non-profit organization, we serve our mission to be a clear, strong, and trusted voice, demonstrating how dads can save America and Western Civilization.

### REMINDER: Lombardo Campaign Office Grand Opening and Office Volunteer Opportunities
---

| Letter from the Chair

Get Involved: Register to Serve as a Delegate for the 2026 Nebraska Republican County Conventions
Dear Fellow Republicans,
As we kick off 2026 with renewed energy, it's time to strengthen our grassroots foundation. The Nebraska Republican Party (NEGOP) is excited to announce that delegate registration is now open for the 2026 County Conventions and the upcoming State Convention being held on Saturday, June 6th!
County Conventions: The Heart of Our Party
Every two years, county Republican parties across Nebraska hold county conventions to conduct essential party business and elections. In even-numbered years like 2026, these conventions also elect delegates and alternate delegates to the NEGOP State Convention. These gatherings are crucial: they're where we elect county party officers and select representatives to influence leadership and key decisions at the state level.
Date and Time
County conventions will be held between March 15 and April 15, 2026. Each county sets its own date, time, and location, with notice published at least seven days in advance as required by law. To find your county's details, isit your county Republican Party's website or social media pages, or contact your county chair via the directory at: [https://ne.gop/about-your-party/in-your-county/](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001t3UbrZLTFpKBpWaUomITXeMPysC1qiSrX0xciP9MV1Kk8GyfAFYT5hVbWnWLvBpH-dVxDXiMsXS0xatkrY19qF5btd-GXHwtMJmdo2oElF5ilIMizaEDzgvXidiQ-4LwlBDAHpvFOxs9whSymaZLIzBnT0tnajPkrEDeBrzrYDgE5CHNKtSM3inb6Gowtnbm&c=NESd9gDkkO8nb346veyh4UhWurBIq-eSFlK_JGXVzt8q8YgNaxPWjQ==&ch=DJI1Fcbb-RYfUwutZU7J2eJX5uoo4tkkfNKHkTaNtGiN_MdKJPiy2g==)
The Role of a County Delegate
Serving as a delegate is a rewarding way to get involved--no prior experience required! Delegates must be:

* Registered Republican voters in their county
* Willing to actively participate in county and state party activities for the two-year term
* Ready to represent their precinct or district
* Committed to volunteering for party business and electing Republican candidates
* Engaged in selecting party leadership

How to Register as a Delegate
The Delegate Registration process has changed this year. The Unicameral passed a bill last session removing the County Clerks and Election Commissioners from the process. All interested individuals must register this year through the official Nebraska Republican Party process.
Online Registration Steps: Visit [https://ne.gop/delegateform](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001t3UbrZLTFpKBpWaUomITXeMPysC1qiSrX0xciP9MV1Kk8GyfAFYT5hVbWnWLvBpHhhwtvN_SQ2Z-MkKdiXksBRJu-VCBMmpv8d5kHvXVDekHYyBMmsgcvy1bx01VSDFnbVLlccSHvN2tCxhTwIJAWuVuQN5rXUV5&c=NESd9gDkkO8nb346veyh4UhWurBIq-eSFlK_JGXVzt8q8YgNaxPWjQ==&ch=DJI1Fcbb-RYfUwutZU7J2eJX5uoo4tkkfNKHkTaNtGiN_MdKJPiy2g==) (available now!) Complete the form with your name, address, county, and contact information Submit the required $5 delegate filing fee by credit card Registration is complete upon submission of the form and payment.
Key Dates and Deadlines Registration Period: January 1 - March 1, 2026 Delegate Filing Fee: $5 per delegate
Participation Matters
County conventions are the bedrock of our party in Nebraska. Becoming a delegate is one of the most direct ways to shape leadership, priorities, and our future success. We encourage every interested Republican to step up and make their voices heard! Together, let's build on our victories and keep Nebraska red.
Sincerely, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

| A message from Nebraska Secretary of State Bob Evnen:
"Last fall, my office received a letter from the Department of Justice, as did every other state, requesting our voter rolls. This request was made to ensure every state is properly maintaining their voter rolls, and to check for any non-citizens who may have registered to vote. Before I could comply with this request, I was blocked by a lawsuit brought forth by a left-leaning organization called Common Cause. This lawsuit, also filed in other states, is an attempt by the democrats to blockade President Trump's election integrity efforts nationwide.
After months of waiting for this issue to be resolved, I made the decision to release our voter rolls to the Department of Justice by February 12th. This has resulted, unsurprisingly, in a letter which was sent to my office this morning by the Democratic National Committee, threatening to sue the State of Nebraska simply for working with the Trump Administration on election integrity. It should surprise nobody that the democratic party wants to prevent us from removing non-citizens from our voter rolls. The Democrats have been opposed to President Trump's election integrity initiatives for years. I, for one, refuse to be bullied by Washington Democrats.
Here in Nebraska, we have voter ID, we have paper ballots, we have hand-counted audits, and we will verify the citizenship of every voter on our rolls. It's time to call the democrats out for their rampant mismanagement and abuse of elections in states like California, Colorado, and Minnesota. We will continue to take a stand here in Nebraska, and we will never back down."
Contact the Nebraska Secretary of State at 402-471-2554

# **We Can Strive for Better...**
Gun violence and its impact on families and communities has been seen nationwide and continues to escalate. While ideas about how to fix the problem vary across party lines, we can all agree that the safety of our children and communities is paramount. No one should have to send their children to school worrying that their child may be the latest victim in a school shooting event. No one should be afraid to attend public events due to the rising accounts of violence.We can strive for better in our nation. We can make sure that our rights are protected by also ensuring that our communities are safe. Common-sense gun legislation and reform are just that - a part of confronting a problem while not punishing responsible gun owners. Those convicted of domestic violence or other violent charges should not be able to easily access firearms. Those with severe and untreated mental illness should not be able to exploit loopholes and obtain weapons with the intent to harm.Unfortunately, we live in a world where people use their second amendment right to harm others, and we cannot allow it to continue and target more and more of our children. **_We can do better and bring forward more nuanced and effective policies to combat gun violence in our nation. Help to bring a voice to Washington that understands the importance of this issue and the many ideas that shape it by chipping in today._**
