name: Rep. Joe Sweeney
subject: The Real Fight for Property Tax Relief in New Hampshire
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Joe Sweeney for New Hampshire, Joe Sweeney Treasurer
body:
The fight - and discussion - is not over.

| | |
---
| | Derek,

Many of you may have heard about the recent debate in the New Hampshire House over HB 675, also known as the Property Tax Relief Act. Given how important this issue is to families, seniors, and anyone trying to stay in New Hampshire, I want to walk you through exactly what happened on the House floor and why it matters.Property taxes are the number one issue I hear about from constituents. You deserve a clear, factual, and honest explanation of how this effort unfolded.
Here is the sequence of events, step by step.
We began by adopting the committee amendment by a vote of 184 to 168. That amendment passed with 182 Republicans voting in favor and 10 Republicans voting against it. This amendment significantly strengthened the Property Tax Relief Act. It incorporated an inflation adjusted formula that allowed for reasonable future growth in school spending tied to inflation and student population. This policy was not imposed unilaterally. It came directly from feedback we heard last year from Republican opponents who said this was what they needed to support the bill. Once it was adopted, however, it became clear that the goal posts had moved.
Next, the House adopted the Kim Rice amendment, which added a 6 percent cap on central office expenditures within the existing framework of the Property Tax Relief Act. This distinction is critical. The amendment did not replace the bill or discard a year of Republican work. It strengthened the bill by placing real guardrails on administrative growth. That amendment passed 177 to 176, with the Speaker breaking the tie. One hundred seventy five Republicans voted to strengthen the bill. Eighteen Republicans voted against it.
**Then came the turning point.**
A new amendment was brought forward, and I spoke strongly against it. Unlike the Rice amendment, this proposal replaced the entire bill. It stripped out the inflation adjustment and the broader spending framework Republicans had built. It replaced all of it with a flat 6 percent cap on central office expenditures, with no overall cap above it. In practice, this would have incentivized more spending, not less. School districts could grow their budgets without limit so long as central office spending stayed under that percentage.
By this point, it was already clear what was happening. We had reliable information that House Democrats planned to vote for this amendment en masse. With only a handful of Republicans joining them, they could replace the entire bill and then turn around and vote against it.
That is exactly what happened.
The vote on the replace all amendment was 182 to 173. One hundred seventy two Republicans voted against this poison pill amendment. Twenty two Republicans voted for it. And one hundred sixty House Democrats voted for it, nearly ninety percent of their caucus, executing the strategy they had discussed the day before. In one vote, the Property Tax Relief Act was effectively destroyed.
Then came the final act. After successfully replacing the entire bill with an amendment they supported, House Democrats went to the well and spoke against final passage.
At that point, the outcome was clear. On final passage of Ought to Pass as amended, only nine Republicans voted yes. One hundred eighty five Republicans voted no, joined by the entire House Democrat caucus.
This was never about improving policy. It was never about delivering property tax relief. Democrats had no interest in limiting spending, even symbolically. Their objective was to create chaos within the Republican caucus, exploit a fissure on this issue, and protect a system that allows spending and property taxes to rise without restraint. And they were willing to do it at the expense of seniors on fixed incomes, young families trying to stay in New Hampshire, and anyone already stretched to the breaking point.
**Despite this outcome, I remain hopeful.**
I am hopeful because House Republicans walked away from this fight more determined than ever to fix our broken property tax system. I am hopeful because the public continues to speak louder every year about how unsustainable property taxes have become. And I am hopeful that those Republicans who believed they could partner with House Democrats to achieve a narrow policy goal, only to watch it collapse immediately, now have a clearer understanding of who operates in good faith and who does not.
I also want to share one line I intended to include in my prepared remarks, because it captures the heart of this fight. Former Governor Meldrim Thomson said it best: “Low Taxes are the Result of Low Spending.”
That truth has never changed. It remains the only path out of our current challenges. Conservatives across New Hampshire must remember it in every battle ahead, because no amount of procedural games or rebranding will ever substitute for spending discipline.
The fight for property tax relief is not over. It is just getting started. I promise to stay in it, clearly, honestly, and relentlessly.
**Thank you for taking the time to read this and for staying engaged in this fight.**
Best,
Joe Sweeney

# [](https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/203?t=1&akid=1297%2E181023%2EqrNcVI)
Hi there,
I've been traveling throughout Michigan throughout the last year as a candidate to be the next governor of Michigan, and, no exaggeration, every stop — from Iron River in the Upper Peninsula to Detroit to Flint to Muskegon — Michiganders have shared heart-wrenching stories about a broken, unfair, inaccessible, and increasingly unaffordable healthcare system.
**_That is why I know this is the defining issue of 2026._**
Our health care system is crushing the hope of the people who have played by all the rules, who are working hard and living within their means, and who still worry every day that they are just one major injury or illness away from bankruptcy.
As leaders in Michigan, we have a moral responsibility to fix this — and I just rolled out my plan to do so ([you can read more here](https://jocelynbenson.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/JB-Affordability-Agenda-v1.png)).
When I am governor of Michigan, ensuring our healthcare system is affordable, accessible, and fair is my priority — and I will work with anyone to get that done, while using every tool in my toolbox.
_**That is my North Star.**_
I’ll do everything I can to get this done for the people of Michigan, because people are hurting and they need us to do something about it. I'm going to be a governor who does something about it, and I'm going to work with anyone and everyone who shares that priority.
**[If you’re with me in this fight and believe in our work to make healthcare affordable, accessible, and fair, please donate to my campaign for governor. name: Kirk Cameron
subject: Bring wholesome messaging back to childrenâ€™s entertainment
body:
Please – for the sake of all our families

| | | You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with "entertainment" that grooms children.
---
| |
---
| | Dear Friend in Faith,Please – for the sake of all our families – take it from me as someone who’s lived and worked in Hollywood my whole life... You are absolutely right if you think Hollywood is reaching right into your family living room with “entertainment” that grooms children.You may remember shows with wholesome messages like Father Knows Best, Marcus Welby, M.D., and even Dennis the Menace.But today when children turn on the TV, they see a Drag Queen leading the Pride Parade on _Blue’s Clues_...
---
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqpjfhsbm9ffobjbdod36j5a4a1so6vv2dd2drdo_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjgeaoj2clh2bs)
---
| | Or Sesame Street using YOUR tax-dollars to normalize same-sex parents and men in dresses.And the result is an upside-down world where children lecture YOU about what you can and cannot say... ...and they try to “educate” YOU about your “old-fashioned” and “mean” ideas.Today you have a very special chance to stop the Hollywood groomers who are turning our children and grandchildren against us and the Godly values we love. **[Today, I’m inviting you to be a Founding Supporter of the very first children’s television show that actively fights back against the groomers in Hollywood AND reinforces the traditional biblical values that made America great.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztrgj1ke6rvr6s383qqf37g5ra2in0d722h80ke8_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjgeaoj2clh2bs)** Introducing: _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.I’m making this ground-breaking live-action television show with the great folks at **Brave Books**.If you’ve seen me and **Brave Books** on _Fox News_ , you know we’ve already countered those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” the Left has been pushing on children in our taxpayer funded libraries. Thanks to support from parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens just like you, we started hosting Godly and patriotic “Story Hours” of our own.And now, THOUSANDS of children and parents can gather to pledge allegiance to our flag, read wholesome books, and pray together in their libraries.It’s encouraging to see we can win when we fight back! Now we’re working to have that same impact in television.
---
>> Imagine a children's show that leaves your child or grandchild with a greater sense of right and wrong and an understanding of truth.Courage, honesty, discernment, forgiveness, empathy, all taught through a biblical and traditional lens. >> Imagine a children's show that brings families together instead of driving them apart.>> Now imagine YOU are the one who makes that show possible. Because we can’t beat the Hollywood groomers without your help as a **Founding Supporter**.
---
The great news is that we’ve already completed and released the first ten character-building episodes of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_! We premiered it recently to a small group of children and parents and I wish you could have seen the smiles on those innocent little faces.And I wish you could have experienced _the parents_ watching their children absorb the beautiful Gospel messages.It was quite a moment for everyone – including folks just like you – who worked so hard to get us that far. But now **Brave Books** has an urgent two-fold problem that I hope you can help with.
---
_**#1. Brave Books needs to launch a massive advertising blitz to get around the groomers on the Left.**_
---
You see, we’ve made the first five episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ available absolutely FREE. That’s the best way we can reach MILLIONS of families with our Gospel-inspired messaging.But no one will see it if we can’t get the word out. And the Left will try to bury _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ at every turn. The price tag for an advertising blitz of this magnitude is $250,000 – and with the recent launch, we need to raise the funds immediately.
---
_**#2. We must complete Season 2 to keep our momentum going and that cost is $250,000 for post production.**_
---
I know that’s a lot of money but it’s actually a fraction of what it would cost if we made our show with a major Hollywood studio. And obviously, we won’t work through Hollywood.Hollywood has done quite enough already to destroy American culture and hijack our children.We parents, grandparents, and concerned citizens must take over to rebuild a thriving, healthy, GOOD and GODLY culture. **[That’s why I’m asking you to please contribute $35, $50, $250, $500, $2,500 or more to help us reach our fundraising goal of $250,000 for advertising and $250,000 for Season 2.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zv1b3clhe2a39gq6rduqblnv58p7k16aec773q2g_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjgeaoj2clh2bs) ** As our special “Thank You” for becoming a **Founding Supporter** at the $50 level, we’ll send you all ten episodes of Season 1 of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ FREE on DVD.This exclusive _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_ DVD is only offered to **Founding Supporters**. It won’t be available for sale anywhere. So with **[**your gift of $50**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztbl1pdga8jsb8u4bq49g8httpnegteu19303reo_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjgeaoj2clh2bs)** , you’ll be part of a small select group of people who own our wholesome TV show on DVD. You’ll have it ready to watch with the children in your life. Or you can drop your DVD by your local school, church, mission, or even leave it in the waiting room at your doctor’s office. So many children have no way of hearing God’s message in their lives. Your random act of kindness may change a child’s life. **[So please – whether you can send $50, $5,000, $25,000, or anything higher or lower, please respond quickly and know that gifts of EVERY size are needed and greatly appreciated.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zligebrr92lmo28h69m12pdk7qno09unsip5sbh0_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjgeaoj2clh2bs)** There’s no time to waste. Hollywood groomers have destroyed America’s Godly culture. But today we rebuild from the ashes.And it starts by ensuring the most innocent among us are filled with faith and family – not filth.Thank you for being a part of history by becoming a **Founding Supporter** of _Iggy and Mr. Kirk_.
---
Sincerely,
---
| | Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)Actor, Author, and Father
---

---
**Kirk Cameron (and Iggy!)** **Actor, Author, and Father**
---
|
---
| | P.S. The #1 thing you can do today to stop the Hollywood groomers who are tearing families apart – maybe even yours – is to support the very first children’s television show in _history_ made possible by contributions from grandparents and seniors like you. **[Please send in your Founding Supporter gift and help me reclaim America with the Biblical values our country was founded upon.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdj8evecuqin037r9409m9fg6h0j258chd5skuq0_rp22sh2s8i6eor7cjgeaoj2clh2bs)** Thank you and God bless you and your family! -- Kirk

name: Rep. Gloria Johnson
subject: The 2026 Legislative Session is Beginning 1/13/26
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF GLORIA JOHNSON, LISA SORENSEN, TREASURER
body:
Republicans are sleepwalking us into economic collapse and societal mayhem

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d3c26470f9be/legislative-wrap-up-7363166?e=dc5f639d62)
---
|
---
| | | | |
---
|
---
| |
Peter

As we head into this year’s legislative session on January 13, I want to be honest with you about where Tennessee stands—and what is at risk if we do nothing. Republicans in control of our state government are sleepwalking us into economic collapse and societal mayhem.
Across Tennessee, families are being crushed by costs they simply cannot keep up with. Too many Tennesseans can’t afford a home. Grocery bills are skyrocketing. Child care is out of reach for working parents. Prescription drugs, doctor visits, hospital care, and even basic utility bills are pushing families to the brink.
The numbers tell a devastating story. According to the United Way of Tennessee, 44 to 50 percent of Tennessee households with children struggle to afford basic needs. That is not a marginal problem—that is nearly half our state.
And it is about to get worse.
Because of the GOP’s so-called “Big Ugly Bill,” Tennessee will be forced to backfill billions of dollars we are losing due to massive cuts to SNAP, TennCare, and child care funding. Before this bill, an estimated 600,000 to 700,000 Tennesseans were uninsured, even with ACA subsidies in place. With those subsidies slashed, that number is projected to rise to 900,000 or more uninsured Tennesseans. That will devastate our hospitals—especially rural hospitals—and drive families into financial ruin.
Meanwhile, 2025 was the most expensive year in history for residential electricity in Tennessee. At the same time, Governor Lee rejected federal funding that would have provided summer food assistance for 700,000 children, even as counties across the state begged him to accept it for food-insecure families. Infant and toddler child care is now more expensive than average in-state tuition!
This is what happens when the government refuses to work for the people it serves.If the government is not actively working to solve these problems, families are in serious trouble. That is the discouraging worldview we are living under with a Republican supermajority that values ideology over people. They put all their power into tax breaks for CEOs and big corporations and handouts for families already in private school.
But Democrats have a different vision for Tennessee.We believe our government should be on the side of working families—not corporate special interests. We are here to: • Raise wages so work actually pays • Provide affordable, accessible health care • Lower the cost of groceries and everyday necessities • Strengthen and fully fund public education • Ensure affordable, high-quality child care • Increase access to safe, affordable housing • Make our schools and communities safer for everyone
In the coming weeks, I will be introducing and supporting legislation that moves us toward that vision—bills that put people first and meet this moment with urgency and compassion.
This work is not easy, and it is not abstract. It is about whether families can not just survive, —but thrive—in Tennessee. I am honored to fight alongside you for a state that works for everyone, not just the powerful few.
If you can donate to my campaign now it would be a huge help as we will no longer be able to take donations after 12:00 noon on Tuesday the 13th, once session has started. [You may click here or at the bottom of the page to donate.](https://gmail.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=08ef345bf32fd78090e04097b&id=3fed8f49de&e=dc5f639d62) Thank you so much for all you do, it’s going to take all of us working together to make sure all Tennesseans thrive!

In solidarity,Gloria JohnsonState RepresentativeTennessee House District 90

_**EXHIBIT 1 - JOINT FUNDRAISING NOTICE **_

Team Nunn ("JFC") is a joint fundraising committee composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn ("Campaign"), Call to Service PAC ("LPAC") and NRCC (each, a "Committee," and, collectively, the "Committees"). Any contribution to the JFC permissible under the Federal Election Campaign Act, as amended ("FECA"), from contributors who have not exceeded their applicable federal contribution limits, shall be allocated among the Committees pursuant to FECA and the formula set forth in this Notice.

_**Contributions Made by an Individual or Federal Non-Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Individuals or federal non-multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $322,100. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $7,000, designating up to $3,500 to the primary election and up to $3,500 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3\. NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $44,300 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $132,900 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

_**Contributions Made by a Federal Multicandidate Political Committee:**_
Multicandidate PACs may contribute up to $120,000. Such contributions shall be allocated in the following order:
1\. Campaign shall receive any contribution not exceeding $10,000, designating up to $5,000 to the primary election and up to $5,000 to the general election, provided such limits apply.
2\. LPAC shall receive any contribution not exceeding $5,000 annually.
3 .NRCC shall receive for its general account any contribution not exceeding $15,000 annually.
4\. NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Building Fund, provided such limits apply.
5 .NRCC shall receive any contribution not to exceed $45,000 for its Legal Proceedings Fund, provided such limits apply.

Contributions to Team Nunn, or to any participating Committee individually, are not deductible as charitable donations for federal income tax purposes. Contributions from corporations, labor organizations, national banks, federal government contractors, foreign nationals without green cards, and other federally impermissible sources are prohibited. The contributor's signature designates his or her contribution to the elections described above. Contributions that exceed a donor's contribution limit to a participating Committee shall be reallocated to the remaining Committees according to this allocation formula to the extent permitted by FECA. Any contributor may designate his or her contribution to a specific participant Committee to the extent permitted by FECA. Federal law requires us to use our best efforts to collect and report the name, mailing address, occupation, and name of employer of each individual whose aggregate contributions exceed $200 in an election cycle or calendar year, as applicable.
Paid for by Team Nunn, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and composed of Iowans for Zach Nunn, Call to Service PAC, and NRCC.

# **ICE agent identified as Trump-supporting Christian war veteran**
Jonathan Ross, 43, has been identified as the ICE agent who fatally shot protester Renee Nicole Good in Minneapolis on Wednesday, with his family **[describing him as a"committed, conservative Christian,](https://substack.com/redirect/cd40c066-514c-46c6-a10f-56ea175d45df?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a tremendous father, a tremendous husband" and an Iraq War veteran who has been with ICE since at least 2013 and is a member of the ICE ERO Special Response Team.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd7076c4-95c8-48f9-8f6f-bc7fc092a6ef?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Ross married to Filipina wife, a U.S. citizen:** Ross married his wife in 2012, with his in-laws being doctors who live in the Philippines, and while his wife is a U.S. citizen, Ross' dad wouldn't say how long she had been in the country, though she has previously shared photos on social media posing alongside a U.S. Border Patrol helicopter.
* **Agent previously dragged 100 yards by illegal immigrant:** Ross had a run-in with an illegal immigrant in Bloomington, Minnesota last June where he was dragged more than 100 yards during a traffic stop after breaking the driver's side window of Roberto Carlos Munoz's car when the Guatemalan serial illegal immigrant refused to exit his vehicle, leaving Ross hospitalized with "significant injuries to his arm and hand" requiring 33 stitches.
* **Trump and Noem defend shooting as self-defense:** President Trump quickly praised Ross' actions, arguing he was acting in self-defense after being struck by the protester's car, while Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem also said he was justified and described the protester as a domestic terrorist, as anti-ICE protests erupted across the country and Democrat leaders ramped up divisive rhetoric.

* * *
# **Renee Nicole Good was a Minneapolis "ICE Watch" member: report**
Renee Nicole Good, the mother of three shot and killed by a federal agent Wednesday after allegedly threatening him with her vehicle, worked as a Minneapolis-based immigration activist serving as **[a member of"ICE Watch,"](https://substack.com/redirect/6d0ad094-9a89-426f-828e-aca0a6fa4e05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** a group that Homeland Security sources told Fox News aims to "monitor, track, interfere and oppose ongoing federal immigration enforcement operations" present in multiple sanctuary cities across the country.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6d0ad094-9a89-426f-828e-aca0a6fa4e05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Renee Nicole Good (ODU English Department/Facebook)
* **Good allegedly followed agents, blocked roadway before shooting:** According to DHS, Good followed federal ICE agents to two other locations prior to the shooting and was blocking the roadway to interfere with ongoing enforcement in the area, with federal authorities now looking into these groups to determine their sources of training and funding, as members described as "legal observers" often attempt to interfere with federal operations.
* **Video shows confrontation before fatal shooting:** Video circulating online shows an ICE officer approaching Good's stopped SUV and attempting to open the driver's side door before the vehicle drives forward, with a second agent standing in front of the vehicle then firing multiple shots at close range in what DHS described as an act of "self defense," while ICE Watch-style networks have been linked to multiple confrontations with federal agents including incidents involving vehicles used to block or strike officers.

President Trump told Fox News Thursday night that **[the US"is gonna start now hitting land with regard to the cartels,"](https://substack.com/redirect/732e6a3e-6078-4387-a364-7e09decaaedf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** declaring "The cartels are running Mexico, it's very sad to watch," while boasting to The New York Times that the only limits on his military powers are "My own morality. My own mind. It's the only thing that can stop me."

* **Mexican President rejects military intervention repeatedly:** Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum confirmed that US military intervention in Mexico has been raised repeatedly in her conversations with Trump but said she has always rejected the offer, viewing it as a nonstarter while insisting their relationship is one of mutual respect, with analysts believing the threats will continue as a negotiation tactic especially as the USMCA free trade agreement is up for revision this year.

name: Patrick J. Murphy
subject: From the Front with Patrick J. Murphy: Leadership, Service, and Reflection on a Year of Change
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/PJM_Logo.png]
From the Front with Patrick J. Murphy: Leadership, Service, and Reflection on a Year of Change
Hi Friends,
Hope your new year has been off to a great start. 2026 brings with it new opportunities to lead with integrity, engage with the pressing issues of our time, and continue building the communities that make this country strong.
To everyone who has been part of this journey, thank you. Your engagement, questions, and commitment make you an essential part of our community, fostering a sense of belonging and appreciation.
On Substack: The 10 Geopolitical Shifts That Defined 2025
This week on Substack, I published a comprehensive look at the ten geopolitical shifts that redefined global power, trade, and security, and how their consequences will impact the world in 2026. It was a condensed piece of what we wrote at Hilco Global.
From the realignment of global alliances to the technological race reshaping national security, understanding these trends is a prerequisite for navigating what comes next in geopolitics.
Read the piece here: The 10 Geopolitical Shifts That Defined 2025 [https://open.substack.com/pub/patrickmurphypa/p/the-10-geopolitical-shifts-that-defined?utm_campaign=post-expanded-share&utm_medium=post%20viewer]
In the Media: Global Leadership and Accountability
This week brought several meaningful opportunities to discuss the challenges facing our nation and the world during these defining moments. For too many, sitting on the sidelines has become the norm.
On Sunday, I had the privilege of appearing on BBC News to discuss the U.S. operation that removed Nicolás Maduro from power in Venezuela. You can watch the full segment [https://substack.com/@patrickmurphypa/note/c-195149103?r=14qjx&utm_source=notes-share-action&utm_medium=web] on my Substack.
We had several other interviews with Bloomberg, Fortune Magazine, podcasts and the Washington Times, but we shared on social media our GB News clip on the Venezuela situation where we made the important distinction that while Maduro is a bad actor, a unilateral offensive operation killing dozens and dozens without congressional approval is unconstitutional. Two things can be true.
On Sirius XM: Venezuela, Executive Power, and Military Precision
I also joined conservative Sirius XM Patriot show Fox host David Webb where we spoke about the constitutional tension between executive authority and congressional oversight and Congress’ enumerated powers under Article I of our Constitution, the strategic implications of regime change in Latin America, and the gravity of military force and America being at her best as the reluctant warrior.
It’s important not to just talk to people who agree with you.
Next Generation Leaders Being Sworn In
We are blessed that great young Americans have taken their oath to support, defend and obey our U.S. Constitution this week across the country, including two Army veterans here in Southeastern Pennsylvania - Danny Ceisler as the new Bucks County Sheriff and Siddiq Kamara as the Delaware County Sheriff.
The two individuals are leaders of character and we’re proud they are now the two honorary co-chairs of the Kennedy Democrats here in Pennsylvania.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/Newsletter.png]
Thank you for being part of this mission. Here's to a strong and purposeful 2026.
Hon. Patrick J. Murphy
32nd Under Secretary of the Army
P.S. Follow @patrickmurphypa on social media and subscribe to the weekly Substack [https://substack.com/@patrickmurphypa] for more updates on leadership, service, and innovation.

If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please unsubscribe: https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/JcTKjLm2l0SduvIvv8SeUg2?unsubscribedata=%2FnOVMwHqQBO%2FKWFbCO6sLJAiA8HFQz2gDKbmxNcrmna9%2FIkSuLXKFEC0KaXLlfDwTk46ywgzkd5Jq%2F8Zexabg62Gq17W3iTpPB2lNd1V4Z4dEs1p16Z54%2FyVCG3vQ81fKtpkxiq4izXo7ipPA7HtN6Gn4Qona46HzndZrFk%2BsXs7ZNfyAggFT5jkDGqUm%2F5DkHBubn6Takz%2BEUS5UNy3IgCF7x8WwGaRfazgxL%2BYuLTaL19UlLefoYmzdjYQB8kqvL6fDoTYb6Mk0oEIvjNAr2SGO5Z7qpzVxmUpK4objiNQY0p%2BvqDMk%2FlUtIpC5fL208TyJafQQ4eDP4uVSg7tGdtsroJHDdPBakOdhS7%2FMHI4d3c6G8Lg3U6a53%2FJVTw6uxKD1tc6ugBpHW%2BixFuLXsKOPeemUOZLRveRlKk0PrFXAY4BVuGpWErtn8Md%2FI6l .

| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | **Hi There,****and Welcome to Team Eileen!** We’re so grateful you’re here. Whether you signed up to volunteer, host a meet-and-greet, or just want to stay informed– thank you. Every person who joins this campaign strengthens our shared belief that public service is about duty, integrity, and community.**About Eileen:****Eileen isn’t a career politician.** She’s a retired Rear Admiral who spent 34 years in the Navy, serving under presidents of both parties. She led teams through complex national security challenges, worked to keep Americans safe, and built coalitions across agencies and international partners.Colorado has been her home for nearly 30 years. It is the place she raised her family, paid taxes, shoveled the driveway, and came back to after her deployment to Afghanistan and every military assignment, including her time at the National Security Council. Through all of it, she watched partisan politics get louder while real leadership, accountability, and basic decency faded from the conversation. So rather than sit on the sidelines, she stepped up again to serve the place she calls home.**This campaign is about doing the work that matters most:**
* **Making Life Affordable Again** — because families who work hard should be able to pay their bills, keep a roof over their heads, and buy groceries without wondering what they’ll have to sacrifice next.

* **Showing Up** — in small towns, farm fields, libraries, living rooms, and VFW halls to listen and learn.

* **Restoring Trust in Leadership** — not with slogans, but with honesty, actions, and accountability.

That’s what Eileen has always done from mentoring young service members, to working with military families navigating deployments and uncertainty. And now, she’s doing it here in Colorado.As part of Team Eileen, you’re helping us build something different- a campaign grounded in respect, hard work, and genuine connection.

name: Ted Cruz
subject: Extraordinary times
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ted Cruz for Senate
body:
What we saw executed on January 3rd – going in with military aircraft to take out the Cuban bodyguards and apprehending Maduro and his wife – without losing a single service member was a moment of incredible strength. God bless the USA.

| | | [](https://trk.email.tedcruz.-nX1Eg3jIQ)
---
| | Fellow Conservative, My heart is filled with patriotism today. Red, white, and blue are pumping through my veins. Russia, China, Iran, and all of our other enemies have taken notice. What we saw on January 3rd was an incredibly complicated operation -- our military taking out the Cuban bodyguards protecting a brutal communist dictator and narcotrafficker, then apprehending Maduro and his wife in a seamless mission to protect AMERICAN interests. And let it be known that not a single American life was lost. God bless our brave men and women in uniform. President Trump and his entire team acted decisively. There were a thousand ways this could have gone wrong -- but it was executed _flawlessly_. The people of Venezuela are better off. The people of the United States are better off because of it.The world is better off as well. _... Just imagine for a moment if Kamala Harris sitting in the Situation Room inside the White House?!_ Think back to the days when Joe Biden and Kamala Harris let Chinese spy balloons fly over our country undeterred. Think back to the humiliating withdrawal from Afghanistan. Those days are GONE. America is BACK! When Republicans hold a majority in all three branches of government, the world is a safer place. And I must admit, I get a bit teary-eyed to see Venezuelans overcome with a hope for freedom. It strikes at something deeply personal for me. **My own father was IMPRISONED and TORTURED for fighting against the communist dictatorship in Cuba.** He fled communism in pursuit of life, liberty, and freedom in America. Saturday was a great day for the world. Do the events of January 3rd make you proud to be an American? Please let me know what you think..... **[[LINK]](https://trk.email.tedcruz.)**
---
[ **READ** ](https://trk.email.tedcruz.)
---
In Liberty,
Sen. Ted Cruz

Unfortunately, earlier this week another _seasoned_ and _respected_ minister of the Gospel confessed to an 8 year affair that has sent shockwaves throughout the Body of Christ. This has become a very common theme lately. Preachers being exposed for their _double life_. **CNN** reached out to me to do an interview about these tragic scandals among American ministers and why they happen as well as if American Christians will forgive them. The reason **CNN** reached out to me is because I just released a brand new book entitled, "[DIVIDED](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27369367.14038.1.80549c8966b6ad75da578782cbc3da41)." This book addresses breaking free from the _double life_ that too many of us in ministry have come too comfortable living in. But this _double life_ is not just isolated to ministers but everyday Christians as well. I never thought in a million years that **CNN** would promote my book... but I guess stranger things have happened. If you are struggling with _secret sin_ and the _double life_ , please **address it NOW**. Otherwise, it will only get worse. I wrote an entire book about my _double life_ and how I have come to experience freedom. I believe it will bless you. Consider getting a copy of [DIVIDED](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27369367.14039.1.6e03741a268aa146d8b74076b512a248) so that you do not have to live divided any longer. Thank you, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer
---
|
---
It is FINALLY here! I have been very busy signing all the pre-orders for my newest book entitled '[DIVIDED: BREAKING FREE FROM THE DOUBLE LIFE](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27369367.14040.1.ed2bcc2d45310eb598e198f96b07b195).' **Pastor Paula White-Cain** wrote an _incredible_ Foreword and **Rabbi Jonathan Cahn** gave an _amazing_ Endorsement. In this, I open up about _my own personal struggles_ as a follower of Jesus and a Pastor. I share things that I've never shared publicly in hopes that it will speak to people who might be ashamed with the different struggles they have even as Christians and how to have victory. There are two of us in all of us but we're not destined to live **DIVIDED** forever. You can visit: [https://clr.cm/qPKQ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27369367.14041.1.234d7779259eda31609819d13b600140)to get your SIGNED copy and start reading immediately with the **FREE e-book** that's included. You can also get a copy on [Amazon](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27369367.14042.1.d65c666454a37e6c64494b5296fa88c5), [Barnes & Noble](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27369367.14043.1.060a5efe2f1163584460bd6727cfe79e), and all other book retailers as well. I believe this book will help many people overcome the double life that far too many of us live. Also, join me on NEWSMAX tonight at 8:45pm EST with David Harris Jr. Thank you -Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer
---

---
| [ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27369367.14045.1.aa5bcab9f8a0f43a93d793b6ed635cee)
---
Every one of us lives with tension - the tug-of-war between the two of us living in all of us. In DIVIDED, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer gets real, raw, and deeply relatable as he opens up about his own struggles with pride, anger, and failure while chasing God's purpose. Through humor, honesty, and hard-learned wisdom, Lahmeyer invites readers to drop the mask, confront the "dark me" that keeps surfacing, and experience the transforming power of grace. This is not a polished preacher's pep talk-it's a gut-level, heart-to-heart conversation about what it means to follow Jesus when life gets messy. Drawing from the lives of biblical characters like Peter, Jacob and Paul, Lahmeyer shows that even the greatest heroes of faith had moments of weakness, doubt, and defeat. He unpacks the difference between remorse and repentance, explores how belief shapes behavior, and reveals how identity-not effort-is the key to lasting transformation. With vivid stories, relatable honesty, and the truth of Scripture, he reminds us that God isn't looking for the perfect version of you-He's after the real you. Because the moment you get real with God is the moment He starts making you new. If you've ever felt like you're living two lives-the public you that looks strong and the private you that's barely hanging on-this book is for you. DIVIDED will help you see that failure isn't final, temptation isn't sin, and your past doesn't disqualify your purpose. You'll laugh, you'll be challenged, and you'll find hope in the God who meets you where you are but never leaves you there. Honest, gritty, and full of grace, this book will inspire you to feed the right wolf, renew your mind, and finally live as the "you" God designed you to be.
---
---
|
---

Democracy Docket: Texas governor threatens state takeover of Houston elections [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=010926_1&amount=25]
Opponents of voting rights are after Houston again, Team.
Texas Gov. Greg Abbott recently threatened Harris County (which contains Houston) with a state takeover of its elections. This is just the latest step in an ongoing escalation of long-simmering threats to gain control of voting in the fourth-largest city in the United States.
Why? Because a GOP state lawmaker alleged that 100 voters were unlawfully registered using post office box addresses instead of street addresses. 100 potentially inaccurate registrations out of more than 2.5 million registered voters and a county population of 4.7 million people -- 0.04% of registrations. Imagine taking over a whole county's elections process over four-hundredths of a percentage point?
The vote suppressors have targeted Houston for years. They started after widespread use of mail-in ballots drove high voter participation during the pandemic, attacking how the county collected ballots. Then Gov. Abbott signed two suppressive bills into law that only affected Harris County and no others in the state. Now he's threatening a full partisan takeover of Houston's voting process in order to restrict ballot access in the county where his party does the worst in elections.
Opponents of voting rights in Texas have gone too far, Team, and we need to fight back. **My piece was published this week by** _**[The Epoch Times](https://substack.com/redirect/cc315eb9-ecf6-4858-af34-844114becbf9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_**.**
What's happening in Minnesota didn't come out of nowhere.
It wasn't an accident.
And it wasn't random.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9rYXRoeWJhcm5ldHRlLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.jmLPiqFmEo088qQsnHueeuXOd654qjZImaheekim1EE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=184038519)
The line readers are responding to most is this:
> _What Americans are witnessing --large-scale welfare and childcare fraud, weak enforcement, political paralysis, and rising public anger--is not random. It is the predictable downstream result of decades of policies made by people who would never have to live with the consequences and who faced few personal costs for getting it wrong._
That sentence captures the argument.
This essay is not about scapegoating communities or collapsing serious policy failures into race. It is about incentives, accountability, and what happens when decision-makers are insulated from the consequences of failure.
You can read the full piece here:

What's happening in Minnesota didn't come out of nowhere. It wasn't an accident. And it wasn't random. The line readers are responding to most is this: What Americans are witnessing --large-scale welfare and childcare fraud, weak enforcement, political paralysis, and rising public anger--is not random. It is the predictable downstream result of decades of policies made by people who would never have to live with the consequences and who faced few personal costs for getting it wrong. That sentence captures the argument. This essay is not about scapegoating communities or collapsing serious policy failures into race. name: Office of U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks
subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- January 9, 2026
body:
|

---
Dear Friends and Neighbors, Happy New Year! I hope you had the opportunity to spend quality time with family and friends over the holiday season, and took time to unwind and reset. As we embark on a new year, I have already hit the ground running and remain laser-focused on continuing to deliver for our families. While 2025 brought uncertainty and chaos across our nation, it also awakened a fight within us. I saw Marylanders speak out and stand shoulder to shoulder in defense of our neighbors and in defense of our democracy. In this new year, we will continue to not cower or look away; we will move forward with resolve to protect our families, to create wealth for our families, and to ensure the health and welfare of our families. Despite the challenges 2025 presented, my team and I are so proud to have accomplished so much on behalf of Marylanders. If you have not had an opportunity, I encourage you to take a look at our [2025 annual report](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.alsobrooks.senate.gov%2fannualreport2025%2f&redir_log=433303210443350) and read about the progress we've made. [](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.alsobrooks.senate.gov%2fannualreport2025%2f&redir_log=433303210443350)
Also, in case you missed it, I would like to share with you a [Washington Post](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.washingtonpost.com%2fdc-md-va%2f2025%2f12%2f21%2fangela-alsobrooks-maryland-senator%2f&redir_log=316581005216585) article on my first year in the Senate, my fight against RFK Jr. and how I've worked in a bipartisan way to deliver for Marylanders while still fighting back against this Administration. You can also check out this [WJLA](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwjla.com%2fnews%2flocal%2fone-year-in-senator-angela-alsobrooks-reflects-on-safety-affordability-bipartisanship-maryland-us-senate-prince-georges-county-washington-dc-tim-scott-cynthia-lummis&redir_log=877922802741365) story. \------------- I wanted to start by addressing the horrific acts we all witnessed out of Minneapolis on Wednesday. 37-year-old Renee Nicole Good, a mother to three children, a United States citizen, was gunned down by a federal ICE agent. I never thought we would arrive at a time where this Administration is shooting unarmed mothers in their cars. We need a full investigation immediately, and based on what I saw in the video - somebody _must_ be brought to justice. This week, I also [spoke to Fox 5](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fx.com%2fSen_Alsobrooks%2fstatus%2f2009362036598391262%3fs%3d20&redir_log=907882982681360) about the smash-and-grab this Administration is doing in Venezuela. Let me be clear: it's all about money. Money for the President's big oil tycoons and billionaire friends. At a time when our country is becoming more and more unaffordable, the President should be focused on lowering costs for Americans and improving the economic outlook for our families. **Fighting for Our Children** As you may have heard, under the "leadership" of Secretary Kennedy, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention slashed the number of childhood vaccines recommended for America's children. At a time where the flu is sickening people all across this country, flu shots are no longer recommended for children. It is asinine to think that Secretary Kennedy - someone with zero medical training - and the anti-vaccine loyalists he impaneled, have made sweeping and unprecedented changes to recommending vaccines that are proven safe and effective. All they have done is sow more seeds of distrust, and create confusion among parents who are seeking guidance to protect some of our nation's most vulnerable - our children. Thankfully here in Maryland we follow the science. I applaud Maryland Secretary of Health Meena Seshamani for immediately [issuing clarity](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fhealth.maryland.gov%2fnewsroom%2fPages%2fStatement-from-Secretary-Seshamani-on-childhood-vaccine-schedule-.aspx%23%3a%7e%3atext%3dStatement%2520from%2520Secretary%2520Seshamani%2520on%2520ch%25E2%2580%258Bildhood%2520vaccine%2520schedule%2c%252C%2520LinkedIn%252C%2520and%2520Bluesky.%25E2%2580%258B&redir_log=240013004211630) to Maryland families. The State of Maryland will continue to follow guidance from the [American Academy of Pediatrics](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdownloads.aap.org%2fAAP%2fPDF%2fAAP-Immunization-Schedule.pdf%3f_gl%3d1%252a1hrix3n%252a_ga%252aOTA1NzYxMTMzLjE3NTY5MDA1MDI.%252a_ga_FD9D3XZVQQ%252aczE3NjQ2MjU1NzgkbzE4JGcwJHQxNzY0NjI1NTg0JGo1NCRsMCRoMA..&redir_log=539301125091224), which is guidance rooted in decades of evidence-based recommendations. **A Statesman** As you may have heard, Congressman Steny Hoyer has announced his retirement at the end of his current term. To summarize the legacy of accomplishments that Congressman Hoyer achieved would require an entire novel -- his impact on the people of Maryland's fifth district -- and people across this nation -- over his storied career is as profound as it is enduring. He is the consummate statesman. A political tactician of the first order. A savvy policymaker. And, most importantly, a man who put service to the people above all else. I know I join the entire state of Maryland when I say "Thank you for a lifetime of service." I do not exaggerate when I say Congressman Steny Hoyer changed my life. It was Steny who first planted the seed in my mind that I could run for federal office. It was Steny who told me, "Any ballot you put your name on, I will be right there with you." And for those of you who know Steny, you know the weight his name carries in our state. When Steny is on your team, you win. I know that firsthand, and I know his constituents do as well. Like many, I am sad to see a dear friend and colleague leave these halls. I learned - and I know all of Team Maryland did as well - so much from Congressman Hoyer. But I'm also so excited for him to get the break he deserves and spend time with his wonderful wife, Elaine. He leaves Congress with his head held high, secure in the knowledge that he has made so many Marylanders' lives better. I know because I am one of those Marylanders.
**Get Back on Your Feet** We are excited to announce a "[Get Back on Your Feet](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdocs.google.com%2fforms%2fd%2fe%2f1FAIpQLSdmXtSIr2pGAxhCCA5RZ2J8BXBJb85ig3p0tbGzu6AQxmllhA%2fviewform&redir_log=89522618923660)" event hosted in collaboration with United Way of the National Capital Area! This event - geared toward Southern Maryland residents - is designed to support Marylanders as they recover from the U.S. government shutdown, manage post-holiday financial strain, and navigate an unstable economy. Utility providers from across the region will be available to help consumers access information and assistance with their bills. Credit counselors, debt repair specialists, legal aid representatives, rental assistance and financial advisors will also be on site to offer guidance and resources. The credit improvement and repair resource table will provide Marylanders with practical guidance on rebuilding credit, understanding credit reports, and accessing tools to improve financial stability, helping them regain confidence and control over their financial future. Additionally, the College of Southern Maryland will incorporate their Center for Workforce Development which offers a range of workforce programs that provide quick credentialing and employment readiness. [](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fdocs.google.com%2fforms%2fd%2fe%2f1FAIpQLSdmXtSIr2pGAxhCCA5RZ2J8BXBJb85ig3p0tbGzu6AQxmllhA%2fviewform&redir_log=89522618923660) **Stay in the Fight ** I know these are difficult times. But please know that I will continue fighting for you every step of the way. We will not give up. We will not give in to this Administration, and I ask that you continue to fight alongside us. Please continue to reach out to us. You can call the office or connect with us at [alsobrooks.senate.gov](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525&report_id=&redirect=http%3a%2f%2falsobrooks.senate.gov%2f&redir_log=346519414955204). You can also follow us on Bluesky, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, and X. We are in this TOGETHER. Sincerely, Angela D. Alsobrooks
United States Senator
[Click here to Unsubscribe.](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/EForm.aspx?__cid=SenAlsobrooks&__fid=100022&__crop=15610.15311487.5838149.7190525)

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]
Peter,
Over the past few weeks, we’ve seen a disturbing pattern of federal immigration enforcement operating with little transparency and even less accountability.
Just days ago in Minnesota, a routine traffic stop by ICE agents turned tragic. A woman was killed, and serious questions remain about why ICE was involved at all, whether proper authority was exercised, and why agents operated without the basic safeguards Americans expect from law enforcement. The ICE agent should be arrested and put on trial.
The American people didn’t vote for ICE to harass U.S. citizens, especially not without oversight, body cams, or accountability. They didn’t vote for ICE to violate people’s constitutional rights or their dignity.
That’s why I’ve introduced a House Resolution to hold ICE and CBP accountable and bring basic transparency, professionalism, and oversight to immigration enforcement.
My resolution, co-sponsored by Del. Eleanor Holmes Norton and Reps. Jonathan Jackson and Jasmine Crockett, calls for:
✅ Mandatory body cameras for ICE and CBP agents
✅ No more masks except in genuine safety emergencies
✅ Independent civilian review boards to investigate misconduct
✅ Transferring ICE oversight to the Department of Justice for proper accountability
As I told CBS News [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ro-khanna-ice-cbp-resolution-immigration/] :
“This is about respecting law enforcement as professionals — but holding them to high professional standards. We should hold ICE officers to the same level of transparency and accountability we expect of police officers or FBI agents.”
What happened in Minnesota underscores what Americans have been saying for years: when agencies operate without oversight, people get hurt.

clean_body: [] Peter, Over the past few weeks, we’ve seen a disturbing pattern of federal immigration enforcement operating with little transparency and even less accountability. Just days ago in Minnesota, a routine traffic stop by ICE agents turned tragic. A woman was killed, and serious questions remain about why ICE was involved at all, whether proper authority was exercised, and why agents operated without the basic safeguards Americans expect from law enforcement. The ICE agent should be arrested and put on trial. The American people didn’t vote for ICE to harass U.S. citizens, especially not without oversight, body cams, or accountability. They didn’t vote for ICE to violate people’s constitutional rights or their dignity. That’s why I’ve introduced a House Resolution to hold ICE and CBP accountable and bring basic transparency, professionalism, and oversight to immigration enforcement. My resolution, co-sponsored by Del. Eleanor Holmes Norton and Reps. Jonathan Jackson and Jasmine Crockett, calls for: ✅ Mandatory body cameras for ICE and CBP agents ✅ No more masks except in genuine safety emergencies ✅ Independent civilian review boards to investigate misconduct ✅ Transferring ICE oversight to the Department of Justice for proper accountability As I told CBS News [] : “This is about respecting law enforcement as professionals — but holding them to high professional standards. We should hold ICE officers to the same level of transparency and accountability we expect of police officers or FBI agents.” What happened in Minnesota underscores what Americans have been saying for years: when agencies operate without oversight, people get hurt. ADD YOUR NAME to support the ICE Accountability and Oversight Resolution. [] ADD YOUR NAME [] This isn’t about partisanship; it’s about protecting both public trust and officer safety. I unequivocally condemn threats and violence against ICE agents. But accountability and transparency make law enforcement stronger, not weaker. Together, we can restore public confidence and ensure that no federal agency operates above the law. SIGN THE PETITION [] Thank you for your activism and all that you do. In solidarity, Ro Wait! One more thing– Ro doesn't accept a cent from lobbyists or PACs, meaning our work is completely funded by grassroots supporters like you. By donating just $3 today, you’re helping us create a country that works for everyone, not just those at the top. That means a renewed investment in American manufacturing, Medicare for All, student debt relief, and a green future. If you want to support our people-powered campaign as we continue to fight for progress in Washington, please consider making a donation of $3 or more today. Thank you! name: Roy Cooper
subject: Beverly
body:
This is why it’s so important to me.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=320%2E124072%2E4lPnjV)
_I’d like to tell you about someone important to me, Peter._ My mom, Beverly Cooper, passed away in 2013 after a long, wonderful life, but her memory continues to inspire me daily. Mom spent decades teaching in public schools in Nash County, where I grew up and where my daughters and I went to public schools. [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/3779?t=7&akid=320%2E124072%2E4lPnjV) _Beverly Cooper (right) at Roy and Kristin’s wedding._ **The dedication my mom gave to her students every day — nights, weekends, and summers included — showed me firsthand the lengths our public school teachers go to give children the best possible start.** As the son of a teacher and a graduate of public schools, I grew up with a deep appreciation for educators and knowing the value of a quality public school education. It’s why advocating for public education has been a priority of mine during my entire career in public service. As Governor, I worked hard to get raises for public school teachers. Across America, too many teachers find they have to work second and third jobs just to make ends meet. Teachers can’t give their best in the classroom if they’re worried about putting food on the table at home, and if we want to hire the best teachers, we need to pay them like the professionals they are. We also invested more than a billion dollars in early childhood learning and care to set our youngest learners up for success throughout their education. Peter, these are the kinds of ambitious investments we need to be making on a national scale. Schools and teachers everywhere in NC and this country deserve the resources they need so each student can get an excellent education that will prepare them for college, a career, or whatever comes next. **Unfortunately, right-wing Republicans in Raleigh and Washington have made it clear that they’d rather take resources away from education than invest in the success of future generations. They attack the teachers who devote themselves to their profession in order to stoke fear and win political campaigns.** _Students and teachers deserve better. They deserve elected leaders who are on their side._ Peter, I remain committed to the fight for public education. _It’s just what’s right._ **[If you can afford a small donation today to help me take this fight to Washington, it would go a long way. My opponents have the GOP mega-donor machine lined up to spend _hundreds of millions_ against me, and I can’t take them on alone.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/3779?t=8&akid=320%2E124072%2E4lPnjV)** | **[DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/3779?t=9&akid=320%2E124072%2E4lPnjV)**

Roy Cooper
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/3779?t=10&akid=320%2E124072%2E4lPnjV)

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

**Wesley voted to renew the expired Affordable Care Act subsidies to ensure as many as 51,000 Missourians can keep their health insurance.[Join him in demanding the U.S. Senate acts now and renews the subsidies. Add your name to his petition.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122988385/594101482/-501822213?ms=em26_260109_acapet_adv_gq_act___TB_ettx&refcode=em26_260109_acapet_adv_gq_act___TB_ettx&source=em26_260109_acapet_adv_gq_act___TB_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260109_acapet_adv_gq_act___TB_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=MF1PnSGlWblZodG5G1EkPZQswpv2AYQ7Z5qdOdODEmJAdlHYn+/jrgoNXQU4BZQsATw96T/nKKwcqjHsIOulO2ysgvtsxZnDvN9juYA3358N4Qv+OOU5uArGkNr3toEJQ17esoJTPmAG1Zqmm2r3pGDR5IQkbE82Ajxx8HdyW7k=&refcode2=37d3b736-82ed-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMzdkM2I3MzYtODJlZC1mMDExLTgxOTQtMDAwZDNhMTFmOTAzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=z9BIQPczXfjBuFmeZ0Gy_FKofIYUrEppjNobdcKEsEM=&emci=1f23b108-b1ec-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=37d3b736-82ed-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&ceid=1020964)**

The Affordable Care Act works because it makes coverage affordable. But the tax credits that keep premiums low just expired, and thanks to the GOP's floundering, costs are going to go up, _a lot._

For many working families right here in Missouri, this won't be survivable. It will mean parents dropping coverage, seniors skipping care, and countless young Americans going uninsured and hoping nothing goes wrong.

We've seen this before, Peter.

**When healthcare gets too expensive, people don't stop getting sick; they just stop getting help.**

The ACA helped cut uninsured rates across the country and protected people from crushing medical debt. Letting these credits expire undoes years of progress in one stroke. clean_body: We need to ensure as many as 51,000 Missourians can keep their health insurance. Peter, Wesley voted to renew the expired Affordable Care Act subsidies to ensure as many as 51,000 Missourians can keep their health insurance. The Affordable Care Act works because it makes coverage affordable. But the tax credits that keep premiums low just expired, and thanks to the GOP's floundering, costs are going to go up, a lot. For many working families right here in Missouri, this won't be survivable. It will mean parents dropping coverage, seniors skipping care, and countless young Americans going uninsured and hoping nothing goes wrong. We've seen this before, Peter. When healthcare gets too expensive, people don't stop getting sick; they just stop getting help. The ACA helped cut uninsured rates across the country and protected people from crushing medical debt. Letting these credits expire undoes years of progress in one stroke. Healthcare access shouldn't depend on how lucky you are or how much money you make, especially not in the wealthiest nation on earth. disclaimer_text: paid for by Walz for Governor
body:
# [](https://act.timwalz.com/go/64?t=1&akid=415%2E34582%2EMN2EsF)
Peter,
On Wednesday, we witnessed a tragedy in Minnesota. Renee Nicole Good — a mother, partner, daughter, and neighbor — died on our streets at the hands of a federal agent.
While we cannot bring back Renee Nicole Good, we can honor her life by standing together for decency, democracy, compassion, and our shared values.
This week, we saw thousands of Minnesotans demonstrate peacefully — sharing the message that this reckless ICE mobilization is not keeping us safe. We saw strength in numbers. We saw powerful peace. We saw a beautiful vigil.
We’ve talked a lot over the last 24 hours about accountability. That means that no function of government operates with impunity, and when someone in a position of authority commits a crime, there is someone to turn to for help.
Checks and balances is the basic idea at the center of the formation of our country, and it’s the only measure to protect against federal power.
State investigators at the crime scene attempted to get that accountability. But we’ve learned that the Trump Administration has denied the state that ability.
Let me be clear: Minnesota needs to do this investigation. These are nonpartisan, career professionals that have spent years building the community’s trust. State governments are vital centers of power and accountability — and must remain that way.
The answer to Trump’s brazen show of force is not to capitulate or bend the knee. We will fight this in court, through public debate, and at the ballot box.
Stay peaceful. Stay safe. We’ll be back with you as we have more.
With gratitude and resolve,
Tim Walz

Friend — ICE is doing everything they can to escalate and make the situation in Minneapolis spiral further out of control.
Just hours after Renee Good was murdered by ICE, federal agents descended on a local high school, detaining a teacher and using violent crowd control tactics on the students. **Attacking kids at a high school. Absolutely sickening.**
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-jan26-ice.iTCV84&refcode=em260109-1-180&t=2&akid=2023%2E791427%2EVind_D)

* “All these men, who were fully armed, suddenly jumped out of the SUVs and started running towards the school.”

* School was being dismissed at the time, and hundreds of students were walking out of the building, she said.

* “Some of the teachers and school workers were trying to keep the Border Patrol away from the students, telling them to stay off school property,” she said. “They just pushed [the teachers] away. I saw one teacher get tackled....The agents started scuffling with the people.”

Here’s an account from Fox 9:
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/4773?t=4&akid=2023%2E791427%2EVind_D)
Friend — I am not going to mince words. **_I’m angry as hell.**_
Angry that these thugs are terrorizing my community on behalf of the President’s personal political agenda.
Angry that innocent people have been beaten, harassed, arrested, and shot at by people who claim they are protecting them.
Angry that they would even THINK to target a school, or to put children in harm's way just hours after they shot a woman dead.
It’s sickening, depraved, and unAmerican. **ICE needs to get out of Minneapolis and face real investigations into their crimes. ICE must be abolished.**
If you feel the same anger I do, if you feel the basic need on a human level to defend your neighbors, consider chipping in to my campaign today.

| | | [](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjk18vO7wfT-2FWuWGj5qYFNqYx7X5ohQ4dCOx5p85so2pLzYV4_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerICDsje9l8d6LPFP-2FzgD5u5Dx5L-2B4-2FfMD8zD7k1j6gUMus18d1-2FnMjo1-2FqKGHcaT11k8sn0mIwubs8v5fR-2FMPbFERVtcg169kQj39T38h-2BIjbzoOva8DVVqUfRUQeduz9RYxYE397OLWyYiA7xNCFTgLY8MJa9b191pJbkSdIMbimoqbUHC9ZkFVjTh-2Bn6dYfCraDhgZ2w8gDU8iMkrbnXdzQ9O5V5TfGQ6r3twv7aD5O8ArQLqnFb4mPziYaYXk-2F)

Dear Friend, January legislative sessions are right around the corner. That usually means the Swamp is already at work—behind closed doors, killing good bills quietly and hoping no one notices.Fortunately, Freedom Caucus members noticed.Let’s get into it.
---
|
---
**SOUTH CAROLINA** The **South Carolina Freedom Caucus** is once again pulling back the curtain on how business is really done in Columbia.This week, SCFC Chairman **State Rep. Jordan Pace** warned the public that establishment forces are trying to quietly kill legislation that would **close Republican primaries** , ensuring that Republican voters—and only Republican voters—choose Republican nominees.That warning didn’t go unanswered.**House Freedom Caucus member Rep. Ralph Norman** , now running for governor, publicly backed Pace and made clear that **closing the primaries will be a priority of his administration** if elected. This is exactly how the Freedom Caucus model works: state leaders and federal leaders reinforcing one another to turn conservative principles into actual law.[Read the tweet.](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjmm6xaDoOOdk6CEjarKDeDnTVlZzrYFaNISvUNoq-2FOewlPSBeAU3O9hkBmyDnSE4vjTQN44wSev0jlxI4u5XZ1s-3DaQAU_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerICDsje9l8d6LPFP-2FzgD5u5Dx5L-2B4-2FfMD8zD7k1j6gUMus18d1-2FnMjo1-2FqKGHcaT11k8sn0mIwubs8v5fR-2FMPbFERVtcg169kQj39T38h-2BIjeupGIGbTPNvQ73jWdAJUHoGFSbQ6CT6TrBCrDnBkK3AXVp2s-2BPv0-2FNFeC2i3LgRdnM1d52qEImG-2FjeL7XE8mY1CgGeffyQIt5b3gYJuZffHYEcUaa9HOVN35xEPo0Q7vsvQ5KrHZmRoFeAzyFVSC1)
---
|
---
**WYOMING** The **Wyoming Freedom Caucus** continues to prove that your State Freedom Caucuses are not just voting correctly during session—they are watchdogs year-round.Last November, WYFC members publicly called out **Weston County Clerk Becky Hadlock** for incompetence in carrying out her election duties. Rather than letting the issue fade, they forced it into the open.That pressure paid off. This month, the **Wyoming Attorney General initiated formal removal proceedings** to remove Hadlock from office.**BOTTOM LINE:** Only when Freedom Caucus members tell the truth and refuse to look the other way, action follows.
---
[](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjppHen015Gx6AaFY6rk-2BtVm24QpTDPSy5-2BCHeVgkv-2Fy0hpmUo9nLP2-2FX4l1tBSsUDu2QyIH6HDxyfDNnHVUfobk-3DDq9m_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerICDsje9l8d6LPFP-2FzgD5u5Dx5L-2B4-2FfMD8zD7k1j6gUMus18d1-2FnMjo1-2FqKGHcaT11k8sn0mIwubs8v5fR-2FMPbFERVtcg169kQj39T38h-2BIhHQ7gnz8-2Fq6CEoOa1hy8vY4lVS-2FmrDk1TgIQNFdQ8kHMzQsmbDF87wT2ei4h4a-2BCjuwwi9DfpHOXbZr5e-2BkDN8MrMtBmz7JXeRria6Bamdcm-2BpKNyLH5NFcXAlVnCDYjUrabsUBFjZdxwLLIGShYeD)
---
|
---
**WASHINGTON, D.C.** Congress is broken. Everyone knows it. And most Republicans, once they get there, quickly learn how to live with it.That’s why the **House Freedom Caucus** exists. This week, the HFC released a straightforward agenda laying out what House Republicans _said_ they would do on the campaign trail—but rarely follow through on once they arrive in Washington. That includes cutting spending, securing the border, and stopping the constant excuses for why nothing ever changes.The House GOP has a decision to make: keep your word to voters, or keep protecting the system that keeps failing us.
---
[](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjpm-2BpDgvC015xZuCd-2FeONRA7IzOSESitM9ZGzk63k3vtp0dzXKdeMl59HewPGVO-2BZQ-3D-3DbgL4_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerICDsje9l8d6LPFP-2FzgD5u5Dx5L-2B4-2FfMD8zD7k1j6gUMus18d1-2FnMjo1-2FqKGHcaT11k8sn0mIwubs8v5fR-2FMPbFERVtcg169kQj39T38h-2BIgnSihniqFuG3BfulB7rBBlcRT7z2eZzpFzcDW9DbDrslKdXlWUE0w-2BgKqYSJnmsYXyDimjtU5paDfZAf0afryDVTNrw9weaheTszBgUD443JycSh9oo6xa8ZumPzV2j5jkD9tdqTY4BAyFhfEZk2Io)

|
---
**QUICK HITS** **Illinois:** Illinois Freedom Caucus Chairman **Chris Miller** delivered a floor speech last year that is worth bringing back. He called out _both_ Democrats and Republicans for growing government. 👉 [Watch Video](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjvCjHmHYh5kawjnNhW84XjOtvlTtDjiLZ6qx0MVuUNl-2BknSZIdIQlqk39lPPfUcOwE5AnFdRjVI6uXbftxGeA8k1nQzB8FsAClxT7k7BTe7mhbq6LgElbimhUm61Drz-2FfXN-2Byavgy62S22lzYvSB0fIMhYe1HCuwj9J3FX4A1LJ9Frk-2FPlDx8vkx-2FTAnMJWM4g-3D-3DLRWl_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerICDsje9l8d6LPFP-2FzgD5u5Dx5L-2B4-2FfMD8zD7k1j6gUMus18d1-2FnMjo1-2FqKGHcaT11k8sn0mIwubs8v5fR-2FMPbFERVtcg169kQj39T38h-2BIjB4i7cGZWg5bWuADGTDo06SZnSieAE7b02cuP0gL5-2BYzyTmU-2FTRXWmMsIxiCR6RXFvog5NFSvVySMvVgY0IrK95iBK6j5YiUN0Ix5E3znpFpU92OWaZH9AgryGs7vjC6WMqOIKG1LDCQiOmJn-2FZ6D-2B) **Maryland:** The **Maryland Freedom Caucus** is the _only_ conservative voice in Annapolis demanding answers about election integrity. In a detailed thread, MDFC exposed how a non-citizen remained on Maryland’s voter rolls and pressed election officials for transparency. Incompetence or intent? Either way, silence isn’t acceptable. 👉 [Read MDFC Tweet](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTjiwkZmtXDP4u12gaI7rwUjbavRoJkhidagNKkMpCHTetWpMCgt08M2ZobvToy1iCU5LBqtvwXKYe-2B-2FZGHFAGIs4-3DVioq_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerICDsje9l8d6LPFP-2FzgD5u5Dx5L-2B4-2FfMD8zD7k1j6gUMus18d1-2FnMjo1-2FqKGHcaT11k8sn0mIwubs8v5fR-2FMPbFERVtcg169kQj39T38h-2BIjubj-2BO2-2Fak-2FRVF7cbpijHmAZbrvpRjBrflXkxkArhZ-2Fj6ZHCVaU0jrqsthrfx-2FXyQzzRLdj56iDr-2Fd1TFpAHECu2d9Xovme3IFbKmRfWoAjI42tJ7WqZ-2FHEUEsir72B7-2BnEw73h2A0bWO76sD2NhcY) **Pennsylvania:** Following the massive Minnesota daycare fraud scandal, the **Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus** called out Governor Josh Shapiro for siding with Minnesota Governor Tim Walz instead of confronting fraud risks at home. Taxpayer dollars deserve protection—no matter who’s embarrassed by the facts. 👉 [Read PAFC Tweet](http://give.statefreedomcaucus.org/ls/click?upn=u001.SSCAglCEkhp55PDWKhWTju2jkVqV7WIujRsG1eAuzXU5yW3JYAZV3181t-2Bc2vSpDbDMZd4mYEg0TKBi3ZZ88C3lLgu4hGx9Oje-2FOyrqY6cE-3Ddyrz_9XnTPLnaEjN9OHWhKYUffDeECIVzR9M-2B5LaO5RH8NVBZyx1SQGGYhOdwcjZYtHerICDsje9l8d6LPFP-2FzgD5u5Dx5L-2B4-2FfMD8zD7k1j6gUMus18d1-2FnMjo1-2FqKGHcaT11k8sn0mIwubs8v5fR-2FMPbFERVtcg169kQj39T38h-2BIhUs0dKbK-2FmL193YlXopKQLy4FeEebk-2BOEym2jb1LFaNWdcL1KdWyABH-2BhgJpCrmrUG6Hk6Fl7qI6ZoUE-2Bv6PYfb33HfXc5iXDlyowK7HoTeOBvSQNJuKLMOhkDVkiWRm67msn1Z45-2FT4zpGcijUhJE)
---
|
---
**HELP US HOLD THE LINE** Legislative sessions are about to gavel in across the country. That’s when the real work begins—and when the Swamp gets dangerous. Bloated budgets, backroom deals, and favors for the politically connected are usually pushed through quietly, with the expectation that no one is watching and voters won’t notice until after the election.Our State Freedom Caucuses are watching. They’re preparing to fight from Day One—to expose bad bills, stop reckless spending, and force debates the establishment would rather avoid. At the same time, we’re working to expand the Freedom Caucus model into even more states so this movement keeps growing.That work takes resources. If you believe the Swamp shouldn’t be allowed to run out the clock while voters are distracted, **we need your help now**. Every dollar strengthens our ability to support Freedom Caucus members, apply pressure where it counts, and make sure these fights happen in the open.

Jordan Pace warned the public that establishment forces are trying to quietly kill legislation that would close Republican primaries , ensuring that Republican voters—and only Republican voters—choose Republican nominees.That warning didn’t go unanswered.House Freedom Caucus member Rep. Ralph Norman , now running for governor, publicly backed Pace and made clear that closing the primaries will be a priority of his administration if elected. This is exactly how the Freedom Caucus model works: state leaders and federal leaders reinforcing one another to turn conservative principles into actual law. | WYOMING The Wyoming Freedom Caucus continues to prove that your State Freedom Caucuses are not just voting correctly during session—they are watchdogs year-round.Last November, WYFC members publicly called out Weston County Clerk Becky Hadlock for incompetence in carrying out her election duties. Rather than letting the issue fade, they forced it into the open.That pressure paid off. This month, the Wyoming Attorney General initiated formal removal proceedings to remove Hadlock from office.BOTTOM LINE: Only when Freedom Caucus members tell the truth and refuse to look the other way, action follows. | WASHINGTON, D.C. Congress is broken. Everyone knows it. And most Republicans, once they get there, quickly learn how to live with it.That’s why the House Freedom Caucus exists. This week, the HFC released a straightforward agenda laying out what House Republicans said they would do on the campaign trail—but rarely follow through on once they arrive in Washington. That includes cutting spending, securing the border, and stopping the constant excuses for why nothing ever changes.The House GOP has a decision to make: keep your word to voters, or keep protecting the system that keeps failing us. | QUICK HITS Illinois: Illinois Freedom Caucus Chairman Chris Miller delivered a floor speech last year that is worth bringing back. He called out both Democrats and Republicans for growing government. 👉 Maryland: The Maryland Freedom Caucus is the only conservative voice in Annapolis demanding answers about election integrity. In a detailed thread, MDFC exposed how a non-citizen remained on Maryland’s voter rolls and pressed election officials for transparency. Incompetence or intent? Either way, silence isn’t acceptable. 👉 Pennsylvania: Following the massive Minnesota daycare fraud scandal, the Pennsylvania Freedom Caucus called out Governor Josh Shapiro for siding with Minnesota Governor Tim Walz instead of confronting fraud risks at home. Taxpayer dollars deserve protection—no matter who’s embarrassed by the facts. 👉 | HELP US HOLD THE LINE Legislative sessions are about to gavel in across the country. That’s when the real work begins—and when the Swamp gets dangerous. Bloated budgets, backroom deals, and favors for the politically connected are usually pushed through quietly, with the expectation that no one is watching and voters won’t notice until after the election.Our State Freedom Caucuses are watching. They’re preparing to fight from Day One—to expose bad bills, stop reckless spending, and force debates the establishment would rather avoid. At the same time, we’re working to expand the Freedom Caucus model into even more states so this movement keeps growing.That work takes resources. If you believe the Swamp shouldn’t be allowed to run out the clock while voters are distracted, we need your help now. Every dollar strengthens our ability to support Freedom Caucus members, apply pressure where it counts, and make sure these fights happen in the open. We'll be back with another update soon. Until then, please be sure to our efforts so that we can support our State Freedom Caucuses!In Liberty, Andy RothPresident State Freedom Caucus Network | |

Hey folks,
I was joined by **Oliver Libby** , author of _Strong Floor, No Ceiling_ , and we got into violence, power, immigration, billionaires, the Democratic Party's identity crisis, and what it actually takes to give people a real shot in this country.
* [**00:01:11**] We react to the ICE shooting in Minneapolis and talk about what it says about power, accountability, and public trust
* [**00:08:17**] Why rushed enforcement, quotas, and lack of training lead to tragedy -- and why pretending otherwise is dangerous
* [**00:17:58**] Oliver explains _Strong Floor, No Ceiling_ and why America feels adrift right now
* [**00:24:01**] Universal basic income, single-payer healthcare, and what a real economic floor actually looks like
* [**00:35:42**] Using power: filibusters, courts, urgency, and why Democrats can't afford to move slowly anymore

This episode is about more than one book or one policy fight. It's about whether we're willing to be honest about why people are angry, why the system feels rigged, and what it would actually take to rebuild trust and opportunity in this country. If you're tired of grievance politics with no solutions -- this one's for you. And if you value honest conversations like this, help me keep them going.
