name: Pennsylvania Forward Party
subject: PA FWD Party January Newsletter
body:
New year, New opportunities

|
## New Year, New Opportunities
Many of us will spend hundreds of hours following politics this year**. Will that time be productive?** Or will it be spent watching endless clips of divisive commentators who make you resent your fellow Americans? Don't give your attention to the voices who weaponize division and discontent. Instead, join us in a New Year's Resolution to spend your political energy building a new way Forward. Refocus the conversation on our state and local communities, where the Forward Party is growing a new generation of leaders—from the grass roots. Here are some ways you can help:
### \---County Lead Volunteers\---
Thanks to everyone who has already volunteered to be the Forward Party contact person in their county. We're holding a **special info session** on Jan 15th for these future county leads (and anyone else who wants more information). Click the link below! [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u6u_UJMP7K7vsJ76YDOs-kzjQtrU51zJMjkgoh57kjDT&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_january_newsletter&n=1)
### \---2026 Convention Planning\---
**Is event planning your thing?** Planning for the 2026 Forward Party convention is just getting started**** and we're looking for people with the skills to help things run smoothly.
### \---Candidate Recruitment and Support\---
Do you want to be where the political action is? This year, we'll be working with Forwardist candidates across PA (for State House and other races). Now is the time to start planning their campaigns and assembling their teams. We want you to help us by recruiting great candidates from your life and community! If you know someone who might run for office, please tell them about the Forward Party. Forwardist candidates are stepping up to be part of the solution, not observing from the sidelines. They will need support from people who share their vision—people of diverse backgrounds, with nontraditional experience**.** You can help us coordinate these races across the state with our Candidates Committee. You can even be trained as a campaign Treasurer! (That's a vital need for a first-time candidate.)
### \---The Best Political Investment You Can Make\---
If you haven't donated to our State Party before, please consider setting up a recuring donation this year. If you want to see the PA Forward Party to truly change the way we do politics in this state, please invest in this vision. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u-umgjlfzqeAM_zj2h1YgEQ8LiKSs_WIlu6d10HpikhG&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_january_newsletter&n=2 "Join our 2026 Donors") [Join our 2026 Donors](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u-umgjlfzqeAM_zj2h1YgEQ8LiKSs_WIlu6d10HpikhG&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2026_january_newsletter&n=2)
---
### \---State Leadership Needs\---
On last month's statewide call, we heard from the Maryland Forward Party about the ways they've been organizing their state party. That started a conversation about the many new things we could be doing in our state! **If you'd like to shape the next phase of the PA Forward Party, the new year is a great time to come onboard.** _Some needs we have are:_ merchandise and graphic design, website management, fundraising, and partner coordination.
**Please reply to this email for more information on any of these opportunities.**

clean_body: New year, New opportunities | New Year, New Opportunities Many of us will spend hundreds of hours following politics this year. Will that time be productive? Or will it be spent watching endless clips of divisive commentators who make you resent your fellow Americans? Don't give your attention to the voices who weaponize division and discontent. Instead, join us in a New Year's Resolution to spend your political energy building a new way Forward. Refocus the conversation on our state and local communities, where the Forward Party is growing a new generation of leaders—from the grass roots. Here are some ways you can help: \---County Lead Volunteers\--- Thanks to everyone who has already volunteered to be the Forward Party contact person in their county. We're holding a special info session on Jan 15th for these future county leads (and anyone else who wants more information). Click the link below! \---2026 Convention Planning\--- Is event planning your thing? Planning for the 2026 Forward Party convention is just getting started** and we're looking for people with the skills to help things run smoothly. \---Candidate Recruitment and Support\--- Do you want to be where the political action is? This year, we'll be working with Forwardist candidates across PA (for State House and other races). Now is the time to start planning their campaigns and assembling their teams. We want you to help us by recruiting great candidates from your life and community! If you know someone who might run for office, please tell them about the Forward Party. Forwardist candidates are stepping up to be part of the solution, not observing from the sidelines. They will need support from people who share their vision—people of diverse backgrounds, with nontraditional experience. You can help us coordinate these races across the state with our Candidates Committee. You can even be trained as a campaign Treasurer! (That's a vital need for a first-time candidate.) \---The Best Political Investment You Can Make\--- If you haven't donated to our State Party before, please consider setting up a recuring donation this year. If you want to see the PA Forward Party to truly change the way we do politics in this state, please invest in this vision. | "Join our 2026 Donors" \---State Leadership Needs\--- On last month's statewide call, we heard from the Maryland Forward Party about the ways they've been organizing their state party. That started a conversation about the many new things we could be doing in our state! If you'd like to shape the next phase of the PA Forward Party, the new year is a great time to come onboard. Some needs we have are: merchandise and graphic design, website management, fundraising, and partner coordination. Please reply to this email for more information on any of these opportunities. | Peter,
The first major test of this year for Democrats is not a congressional or senate race.
In April, the Wisconsin Supreme Court is back on the ballot, and MAGA has their eyes fixated on the court again.
You remember what happened last spring. Elon Musk dumped over $20 million into the race to try and buy the court. Democrats fought back, raising enough money from small dollar donations and outorganized the richest man in the world.
It embarrassed Trump so badly he threw Musk out of the White House and his role at DOGE. Then Elon and Trump had a public breakup, and Musk mostly vanished from politics for the rest of 2025.
But now, Elon is back... just in time for Wisconsin Dems to kick his ass again.
---

We have four months to organize another defense of this court and MAGA sees it as their opening to claw their way back while Democrats are focused on the House and Senate. Elon is out from the shadows and bankrolling MAGA again and they're plotting revenge for what happened in 2025.
Just like last year, this race will set the tone for Democrats in 2026.
Defend Our Courts is suiting up for this battle. After our huge success in helping protect the PA Supreme Court in November, we are expanding nationwide. Wisconsin is our first major target and we are bringing the same winning formula forward.
But here is the reality. When we launched our defense of PA, we had six months to build our operation. For Wisconsin, we only have four. Two fewer months to raise the money, build the program, and get ready to defeat MAGA again.

Again and again, ICE and federal agents act with violence, shielded from
accountability, while Trump and his loyalists declare “case closed” before
any facts are known. 14 people have been shot by ICE in the past year. 4

A woman was killed during an ICE operation in Minneapolis.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122991652/594112210/150430950?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTMyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YmY3YmFjYi04N2VkLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8-k5sebTKdLDfu1GXLeb6O7-OnUaw3kV07-cSQntX_8=&emci=eb4bce57-7ced-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&emdi=8bf7bacb-87ed-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&ceid=7731215)

| | **This week, a woman named Renee Nicole Good was killed during an ICE operation in Minneapolis.** That loss of life is unspeakable. Any time federal law enforcement actions result in a civilian death, the American people deserve clear answers, transparency, and accountability. Instead, the Trump administration has responded by denying reality and blocking access to evidence in the investigation — telling the public not to believe eyewitness accounts, video evidence, or the concerns of the community. **And just one day after Renee Good was gunned down in Minneapolis, federal agents shot two more people — this time in Portland, in my own neighborhood. I am furious.** I am praying for their recovery, and my heart goes out to their families, who have been plunged into pain and uncertainty. Masked federal agents operating in our communities without clear identification, accountability, or transparency create fear — and lead to harmful and deadly outcomes. ICE has been terrorizing communities at the behest of an authoritarian strongman, and they have done nothing to make our communities safer. **History has a word for this kind of government behavior: fascism.** We need full transparency about what happened, including the roles of both ICE and CBP, and full accountability through an independent investigation with local and state participation. There is no reason to trust statements coming from the Department of Homeland Security when it has repeatedly misled the American people. That's why I am demanding accountability for the killing of Renee Good, for the shootings in Portland, and for ICE's dangerous enforcement operations more broadly. I will continue fighting to get ICE out of our communities and to pass my legislation requiring all federal law enforcement officers to clearly display identification at all times. No one should fear disappearing into an unmarked vehicle. No family should be left without answers. ICE must end these dangerous operations in Oregon now. I will keep standing up for the truth, for accountability, and for the fundamental principle that the rule of law applies to everyone — including the federal government itself. # Venezuela's rare earths threaten China's monopoly
Venezuela's estimated 300,000 metric tons of rare earth minerals could help **[slash U.S. reliance on China,](https://substack.com/redirect/47e94f68-680a-41a6-b150-1dafb42d5ce8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** which dominates 70% of global production and 90% of processing, amid post-Maduro geopolitical shifts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25624b50-49ae-447c-9a70-98bb00077395?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Expert estimates reserves:** Venezuela holds about 300,000 metric tons of rare earths, roughly half of China's known reserves, tied to the Guayana Shield's monazite sands and other deposits.
* **China 's supply dominance:** Beijing controls 70% of mining production, 50% of global reserves, and 90% of processing, creating a major bottleneck for critical tech and defense materials.
* **Chinese influence in Venezuela:** Prior to Maduro's capture Chinese firms, alongside Iranians, have advanced into Venezuelan rare earth supplies, potentially bottlenecking resources even as U.S. interests grow.
* **Long-term development timeline:** Extracting and utilizing these minerals would require three to six years of infrastructure building, positioning it as a strategic but gradual play in U.S.-China competition.

# Defense stocks soar as Trump demands Trillion Dollar boost
US **[defense stocks surged Thursday](https://substack.com/redirect/805cd920-67e8-4095-8d14-a622be716119?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after President Trump called for a staggering $1.5 trillion military budget in 2027, rebounding sharply from prior losses tied to his threats against dividends and buybacks amid escalating geopolitical tensions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/805cd920-67e8-4095-8d14-a622be716119?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **L3Harris Leads Gains:** L3Harris Technologies and Huntington Ingalls each climbed 11% in the first five trading days of 2026, fueled by recent US military action in Venezuela.
* **Drone Maker Explodes:** AeroVironment jumped over 40% recently, highlighting investor bets on evolving warfare technologies in a tense global environment.
* **Global Rally Spreads:** European firms like BAE Systems rose 5% and Asian players including Hanwha Aerospace advanced, as Trump pressures allies to increase defense spending.
* **Analyst Bullish Outlook:** Experts cite the hawkish administration and reasonable valuations as creating excellent risk-reward, with potential for further gains despite policy uncertainties.

### Rolls-Royce smashes records Every. Single. Day. of 2026
Rolls-Royce shares have **[surged to fresh record highs](https://substack.com/redirect/af6017da-c409-4729-9d33-22c78e7bf96a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** every trading day in 2026 so far, fueled by escalating geopolitical tensions sparking a defense stock rally after U.S. actions in Venezuela and talk of Greenland control.
* **Geopolitical Tensions Ignite:** Defense rotation sweeps European markets, with U.S. attack on Venezuela capturing leader Nicolas Maduro and Trump's Greenland ambitions driving broad gains in peers like BAE Systems, Rheinmetall, and Saab.
* **Power Systems Thrives:** Order intake jumps 85% year-on-year in this segment, which benefits from shorter governmental cycles in land and naval defense plus "huge potential" in data centers powering AI growth.
* **Analyst Upgrades Boost:** UBS hikes price target to 1,625p citing upgraded power generation sales forecasts (26% from 2028) and potential 60% EBIT rise in power business from accretive data center deals.
* **Civil Aerospace Turnaround:** Largest revenue unit progresses as long-term recovery story with jet engines for Boeing and Airbus, complementing stable 25% defense revenue and U.K. small modular nuclear reactor backing.

# BlackRock declares crypto revolution just beginning
BlackRock's ETF chief declared spot Bitcoin and Ethereum funds "still so early" despite two years of trading, predicting **[2026 as the year retail investors flood into cryptocurrency exposure](https://substack.com/redirect/d27ea6ab-e3a1-48f6-b6c5-6a3eed735037?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid ongoing education and growing loyalty.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/19ffb477-6131-42e2-8359-f040d1bbdd9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Early adoption phase** continues as many investors begin their educational journey on Bitcoin's portfolio role, with BlackRock viewing current ETF traction as the starting point for mainstream integration.
* **Advisor access expands** dramatically through spot Bitcoin ETFs like IBIT, enabling financial advisors who previously lacked crypto options to now offer clients regulated exposure.
* **Investor loyalty shines** amid volatility, with holders sticking to crypto ETFs rather than selling quickly, signaling strong confidence in long-term cryptocurrency trends.
* **Market pullback context** follows Bitcoin's record $126,000 high in October, now trading in the low $90,000s, yet BlackRock remains bullish on future retail appetite growth.

* **Central Bank Buying** and ETF inflows continue fueling gold's rally alongside a weaker US dollar and policy uncertainty.

# Litigation scandal looms if SCOTUS keeps Big Oil pollution suits local
Legal experts are **[sounding the alarm](https://substack.com/redirect/e1967848-2cf9-44d9-bc8a-134694d3e20a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that the Supreme Court must shift massive Gulf Coast pollution lawsuits against Chevron and ExxonMobil to federal courts, or risk the biggest scandal in the U.S. litigation system through unchecked local bias in Louisiana.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e1967848-2cf9-44d9-bc8a-134694d3e20a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Local bias fuels** massive verdicts, with a 2023 Plaquemines Parish jury hitting Chevron with a $740 million award for historical wetlands damage tied to its former subsidiary Texaco.
* **Over forty cases** pending against oil giants seek billions in total for alleged coastal erosion in Louisiana's Gulf region, linked to decades-old operations including WWII-era federal fuel production.
* **Federal contract defense** allows companies to argue these suits belong in federal court to avoid "hometowning," where local juries allegedly favor plaintiffs against out-of-state energy firms.
* **Energy agenda threatened** as failure to intervene could deter investment in U.S. oil and gas production amid President Trump's push for energy dominance, experts warn of "climate extortion" risks.

Here's the headline: **Elon Musk is back. **

Musk has begun funneling major dollars into Republican primaries and general election efforts for 2026, writing huge checks to help the GOP hold (and expand) power in the House and Senate.

And when billionaires swoop in to tilt the scales, we can't afford to play catch-up. We need to stand strong from day one.

That's why EMILYs List is building the biggest, smartest, best-funded program possible for Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot. Your support makes this work possible:
* We monitor and analyze GOP fundraising trends in real time.
* We invest early in Democratic pro-choice women — _before_ big money crowds the field.

And when billionaires swoop in to tilt the scales, we can't afford to play catch-up. We need to stand strong from day one. That's why EMILYs List is building the biggest, smartest, best-funded program possible for Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot. I know it’s almost the weekend and you’re getting ready to log off and spend time with friends and family. But before you do, I have a request:

[_**Will you pitch in $5 or more to my reelection campaign to win in Virginia and flip the Senate blue?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122992526/594114989/-1720966344?amount=5&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_BeforeWeekend_260109_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWVhYTNjNy04YWVkLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VPUcIYkrtYjMq4BaEXwiKoJjSRXGtyxfpfjMXTUKuyU=)

I've seen comfortable leads evaporate on Election Night. I've watched vote counts come down to the wire. And I've learned that the only thing that matters is whether we did everything we could before the polls closed.

That's why I'm taking nothing for granted this year.

But I also know I have one of the strongest grassroots teams in the country behind me. It’s folks like you giving what you can, when you can, that will keep this seat blue and flip the Senate.

[_**Let’s show them what this team is made of. Before you log off, can I count on you to chip in $5?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122992527/594114990/-1720966344?amount=5&refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_BeforeWeekend_260109_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ZWVhYTNjNy04YWVkLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VPUcIYkrtYjMq4BaEXwiKoJjSRXGtyxfpfjMXTUKuyU=)

Enjoy your weekend,

Mark Warner **Before you go:**

Republicans will spend whatever it takes to hold onto power, no matter how unpopular their agenda is with voters.

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: It’s official
body:
Today, I’m launching my reelection campaign to keep moving Pennsylvania forward – and keep getting stuff done.
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260109-1.gjrb9t&refcode=em-20260109-1&t=1&akid=1183%2E1086043%2EzLNDFr)
Peter, I wanted you to hear it directly from me. **I’m officially launching my reelection campaign for Governor of Pennsylvania.**
Hear me on this: we've gotten a whole lot done, on issues that have been stuck for decades. But there's always more to do. More people to help. More Pennsylvanians to protect. More bridges to build.
That’s why I’m running for reelection — to build upon the foundation we’ve laid, put more points on the board for Pennsylvania families, and keep getting sh*t done.
**[Peter, I hope you’ll split a donation between Wes Moore and me to become a Founding Donor to our campaign. Our team just set an ambitious Launch Week goal, so we’re going to need a lot of help to reach that milestone and build all the momentum we’ll need to win this race and keep Pennsylvania moving forward.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260109-1.gjrb9t&refcode=em-20260109-1&t=2&akid=1183%2E1086043%2EzLNDFr)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260109-1.gjrb9t&amount=5&refcode=em-20260109-1&t=3&akid=1183%2E1086043%2EzLNDFr)**
Growing up in Montgomery County, my parents raised me with a core set of values: Work hard. Give back. Stand up for others. And Peter, they led by example. As a pediatrician, my dad helped lead kids and families through the stress of challenging, uncertain moments. And as an educator, my mom taught me and so many other kids to care about the world around us.
Watching their work up close inspired me to follow in their footsteps — but in a different way. Instead of medicine or education, I wanted to help Pennsylvanians through public service. By cleaning up our government, solving problems, and making life better for the families I served.
That’s what I did as a State Representative, when I helped pass some of the toughest ethics laws in Pennsylvania history. It’s what I did as Attorney General, when I got justice for survivors of sexual abuse, protected health care access, and won in court dozens of times to defend our democracy. **And Peter, it’s what I’m doing right now as Pennsylvania’s 48th Governor.**
Together, we’ve cut taxes seven times, putting millions back into the pockets of parents, seniors, and small businesses. We’ve invested a record amount of money in public education and served over 90 million free breakfasts to Pennsylvania students. We’ve created over 18,000 jobs, grown our economy, and expanded opportunity across our Commonwealth. And yes, we’ve protected abortion rights, ensuring every Pennsylvanian has the freedom to access the health care they need.
**But my work isn’t finished.** Today, Pennsylvanians are facing unprecedented challenges with a White House hell bent on raising costs, attacking our freedoms, and undermining our democracy.
And this year, we have the chance to defeat the politics of chaos, division, and extremism that are making it harder across our Commonwealth. We have the opportunity to show the nation that hatred and division are not the way forward. That means standing up to the politicians who enable Donald Trump and JD Vance – even when they know their policies hurt Pennsylvanians.
**[Peter, let’s keep moving our Commonwealth forward together. It’s going to take a full team effort here, and the success of our campaign will come down to grassroots supporters like you. So I’m humbly asking: Can you join our team by rushing a split donation between Wes Moore and my campaign and become a Founding Donor?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260109-1.gjrb9t&refcode=em-20260109-1&t=4&akid=1183%2E1086043%2EzLNDFr)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260109-1.gjrb9t&amount=5&refcode=em-20260109-1&t=23&akid=1183%2E1086043%2EzLNDFr)**
Thank you so much for your support. Let’s get to work.
Josh Shapiro
Governor of Pennsylvania

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. _**by Ellie Leonard, BAM Contributing Editor**_
On July 2nd, 2020, nearly a year after Jeffrey Epstein's arrest at Teterboro Airport, and seven months after the FBI began searching for her, Ghislaine Maxwell was arrested on a 156-acre property in rural New Hampshire. She would be indicted on six counts, including "conspiracy to transport minors with intent to engage in criminal sexual activity" and perjury.
But how Maxwell got to New Hampshire is a piece of this puzzle that may have surprised us all when it was discovered at her bail hearing (which she was denied) that she was married. In fact, she was considering divorcing her husband of nearly four years "to protect him...from the terrible consequences of being associated with her." But who was he, and how did he get mixed up with the Epstein case this late in the game? And how did he end up with Ghislaine Maxwell, the biggest co-conspirator of them all?
Let's go back a few years.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6aba3709-5457-4b8c-a9b1-23d0662af65f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In 2012, Maxwell started the _TerraMar Project_ , a conservation group aimed at protecting the world's oceans. She spoke on behalf of the project at the 2013 Arctic Circle Assembly in Reykjavik, Iceland. It was there that she met a young CEO of a maritime innovation company, Scott Borgerson, who served on the board of the Assembly and had been chosen to moderate a discussion on "Business in the Arctic." Drinks were poured. People mingled. And by the end of the night, Maxwell was smitten with the environmentally-driven former Coastie, whom she'd later tell her friends was a Navy SEAL. These same friends would tell the tabloids that Maxwell had a "singular ability to mythologize her own reality" (i.e., _lie)_.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a1ca7012-86c4-4af8-a839-c9493c855cde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Before long, Maxwell hired Borgerson to work as the director of TerraMar, though there didn't seem to be any actual work to do, nor did the project donate money or provide assistance anywhere in the environmental and oceanic landscape, and it would fizzle out around the time of Epstein's arrest in 2019.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6aba3709-5457-4b8c-a9b1-23d0662af65f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Arctic Circle Assembly
Without getting too conspiratorial here, Borgerson fit. Think Robert Maxwell. Think Jeffrey Epstein. Think sudden funds and international relations that don't make sense. Borgerson, whose mother taught high-school French and Spanish and whose dad was a Marine infantry official, nearly ended up as a Presbyterian priest before attending the Coast Guard Academy, then Tufts for a master's in Law and Diplomacy, and then a PhD in International Relations. In 2007, he served as a fellow in residence on the Council on Foreign Relations and wrote for their online magazine for nearly five years. In 2010, he founded CargoMetrics, a data analytics and maritime trade firm based in Boston that focused on ship-tracking data and global trade. Combine foreign languages, law, diplomacy, and international relations with shipping and data and global trade, and you have the perfect Maxwell-era protege.
> #### "There's a lot that motivates me, including -- if I'm honest -- I have a big chip on my shoulder to beat the prep school, Ivy League, MBA crowd. They're bred to make money, but they're not smarter than everyone else; they just have more patina and connections." \- Scott Borgerson
By the time Maxwell met Borgerson, he was married with two small children and worth several million dollars. But a year later, his wife would file for divorce and move out of the home they'd been renting in Manchester, Massachusetts. Soon after, Borgerson and Maxwell quietly combined their assets of nearly $23 million, and on June 30th, 2016, she sold her Upper East Side mansion for $15 million. But three days prior to the sale, and three days prior to the purchase of Borgerson's rented home, a new LLC was formed, _Tidewood_ , run by Borgerson and a quiet partner, "Jennifer Ellmax."
Upon further inspection, there _is_ no "Jennifer Ellmax."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6aba3709-5457-4b8c-a9b1-23d0662af65f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Their home in Manchester By the Sea, Massachusetts - BackGrid
Maxwell and Borgerson purchased the 6,113 square foot home for $2,450,000 and moved in, prepared to live their life in private as Maxwell fought the 2015 defamation lawsuit against Virginia (Roberts) Giuffre. The lawsuit alleged Maxwell had repeatedly and publicly called Giuffre--who had accused both Epstein and Maxwell of sexual abuse--a liar, claiming she'd made up all the stories about the island, the planes, the world leaders, and especially Prince Andrew.
> #### "...and this bullshit, I believe that this whole thing was manufactured. And I can point you to some potentially corroborating evidence of this... [LAUGHTER]" \- Ghislaine Maxwell
But soon all that was in the rearview mirror, as Maxwell settled with Giuffre for an undisclosed amount and planned to live out her life with her new husband near the ocean they loved.
But on July 6th, 2019, Jeffrey Epstein was arrested at Teterboro Airport, indicted on two counts of sex trafficking minors, and Ghislaine Maxwell's perfect world by the sea began to collapse. And just as the FBI added her to their list of co-conspirators, Maxwell hightailed it out of her Manchester-by-the-Sea estate and disappeared in what would become an international manhunt that crossed the United States, Europe, and Israel.
* * *
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.UenDK6nfG5vkWCXshlpgN9AP3qxSvAL34Zq0yosl-dg?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=183982431)
* * *
But she hadn't gone far. In fact, Ghislaine Maxwell and Scott Borgerson had done it again, starting another LLC two hours north in Bradford, New Hampshire. Under the guise of "Granite Reality," the pair purchased another home from an unsuspecting realtor who referred to them as "Scott and Janet Marshall." Janet was a journalist who just wanted privacy. Scott had retired from the British military and was writing a book. She said they both had British accents, and it could be that Maxwell had brought along one of her security guards to pose as "Scott" as they scoped out the new property.
> #### "...he was retired from the British military and he was currently working on writing a book. Janet Marshall described herself as a journalist who wants privacy. They told the agent they wanted to purchase the property quickly through a wire and that they were setting up an LLC." \- U.S. v Ghislaine Maxwell
On July 2nd, 2020, the FBI surrounded Maxwell's New Hampshire property, after using cellphone and financial records to find her. When they knocked on her door, she fled to an interior room in the house. Her lawyers would deny this, claiming she was in her pajamas and that the front door was unlocked, which the FBI knocked down. When they apprehended her, she was holding a phone wrapped in tinfoil and standing behind her security guard, one of a British team she'd hired to surveil the property while the FBI closed in.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6aba3709-5457-4b8c-a9b1-23d0662af65f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Their home in Bradford, New Hampshire
They took her into custody and booked her into the Metropolitan Detention Center in Brooklyn, charging her with 6 counts of transporting minors to engage in criminal sexual activity. She'd be convicted on five of the charges in December 2021, sentenced six months later, and has spent the last four years perjuring herself in hopes of a pardon from the Trump Administration. In July 2024, she sat down with U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche to plead her case. As a result, she was moved from a low-security women's prison in Florida to a minimum-security ("club fed") in Texas, where she's seen a bump in her amenities.
* * *
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=183982431&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTgzOTgyNDMxLCJpYXQiOjE3Njc5ODY4NzksImV4cCI6MTc3MDU3ODg3OSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.RJPT-9ra7kMyRKCi-AWzKmLiBcgZproigPor8o2aFhQ)
* * *
Scott Borgerson has retreated from public life, resigning his position at CargoMetrics and co-founding a small green-energy startup, H2X. His marriage to Maxwell reportedly ended over a phone call while she was in solitary confinement, though there appears to be no record of a marriage license anywhere. So maybe it was love; maybe it was business. Maybe legitimate; maybe common-law. But by all accounts, he's moved on and is rumored to be dating a 50-year-old yoga instructor out of Manchester. He still has Maxwell's dog, a purebred vizsla named "Secretary Hamilton," and likely he still has some of her assets. Because in 2022, a law firm out of Colorado sued Borgerson, along with Maxwell and her brother Kevin, for unpaid legal fees to the tune of $956,000. Borgerson would settle out of the case; the firm is still pursuing the Maxwell siblings.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6aba3709-5457-4b8c-a9b1-23d0662af65f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Borgerson and "Secretary Hamilton"
Borgerson sold the Manchester home in 2023 for $5.85 million, but still owns their home in New Hampshire and is reportedly worth $20-$25 million.
Ghislaine Maxwell is scheduled to be released from federal prison on July 17, 2037.

Let’s be clear about what’s happening right now — because the people in
power are counting on you not understanding it.

Across the country, ICE agents are snatching people off the streets and
forcing them into immigration “courts” where people are detained
indefinitely, deported into danger, and ripped away from their loved ones
through a system designed to move fast and ask few questions.

The structure is intentional.

Inside these courtrooms, toddlers as young as three are expected to
represent themselves. Hearings proceed without full translation. Evidence
rules are weak or nonexistent. Prosecutors face no consequences for
breaking their own procedures. Judges can bend or ignore the rules
altogether. And this harm doesn’t stop with ICE.

The judges overseeing these cases and prosecutors pushing for deportation
answer to the same people: Pam Bondi, Kristi Noem, and Donald Trump.
Together, they form a coordinated pipeline — arrest, detain, deport.

Under Donald Trump and his allies, this machinery has accelerated. Old
laws are being twisted to justify prolonged detention without hearings and
deny people any real chance at release — often from detention centers that
function like prisons in everything but name.

Families are ripped apart. Children grow up without parents. Entire
communities live in fear, knowing a single encounter with ICE can erase a
life overnight.

Demand Justice PAC exists to confront systems like this. We challenge
courts that serve political power instead of justice, expose executive
overreach hiding behind legal process, and refuse to accept a system where
due process disappears for immigrants. But we can’t do this alone.

Our right to vote has never been more important. We've never truly faced threats like this before, and with the midterms coming up fast we have to do everything possible to combat voter suppression, register voters, and ensure we actually have free and fair elections to vote in.
We have to stop the opponents of voting rights before we lose our fundamental right to vote. RUSH $25 or more right now to help us fight back >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=010926_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
“How we have to even run against these people—I won’t say cancel the election, they should cancel the election, because the fake news will say, ‘He wants the elections canceled. He’s a dictator.’ They always call me a dictator."
That was Donald Trump, Team, speaking to members of his party in the House of Representatives on the 5th anniversary of his supporters storming the Capitol to overturn an election he lost.
How many times has Trump "joked" about something he wanted to do before he did it? Too many to count, including weaponizing the government to attack his opponents, his attack on Venezuela, and his attacks on mail-in ballots.
Now, apparently, he's "joking" -- and not for the first time -- about canceling the upcoming midterm elections. It's a threat we all have to take seriously, regardless of party affiliation, because our country was founded on the idea that our voices matter, not just the voices of the powerful.

body:
Trump’s actions are putting Americans in danger.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2750%2E4032634%2Epq5Ryk)
---
What happened in Minneapolis this week is inexcusable. My heart is with Renee Nicole Good’s family and loved ones. ICE is out of control. This rogue agency should not be able to act with impunity after shooting and killing a woman. Donald Trump and ICE must be reined in by Congress and the courts before more people get hurt. We cannot wait until the next horrific atrocity in broad daylight to confirm what we already know: These escalating ICE raids don't make us safer — they intentionally stoke fear and tear communities apart. Nobody is safer because of these massive ICE and National Guard invasions taking over in our cities. Nobody is safer when families are being ripped apart. Nobody is safer as federal agents intimidate people for exercising their First Amendment right of free speech. Nobody is safer with masked agents sitting outside of churches and schools, driving unmarked vans and breaking car windows, and stealing people off the streets. Donald Trump promised to make America safer, meanwhile he’s threatening to drag the country into an illegal war over oil in Venezuela and terrorizing our communities with masked agents in the streets. This cannot be normalized — and I’m doing everything in my power to hold this Administration accountable, rein in this dangerous chaos, and urge the Republicans in Congress to stand up and speak out on this. Elizabeth

Friends, what happened in Minnesota this week is horrifying.
First, my heart is with the victim of this tragic shooting and her loved ones. Renee Nicole Good should be alive today. Her children should not be growing up without their mother.
ICE has repeatedly shown a disregard for human life, and has continually ignored basic law enforcement practices designed to keep communities safe. Targeting innocent people, ripping families apart, undermining trust in law enforcement. For Trump’s ICE, cruelty is the point.
We can’t accept it — we won’t accept it.
I join the call from so many others, including Minnesota Attorney General Keith Ellison, for transparency, accountability, and an independent investigation. And that same transparency and accountability must apply everywhere — in Minneapolis, in Portland, Oregon where CBP shot two people just yesterday, and anywhere federal agencies are abusing their power and putting lives at risk.
Instead of conducting a full, impartial review of the shooting in Minnesota to ensure appropriate accountability, the President, Kristi Noem, and the entire Trump administration are gaslighting the public. They’re promoting disinformation in a blatant attempt to obscure the truth and frustrate justice.
No sympathy. No humanity. No attempt to fulfill their responsibility to be leaders for all of America.
I stand with every concerned and outraged Californian and American, and I will keep fighting with every ounce of power and platform I’ve got to keep our state and country safe from this administration’s relentless, cold-blooded cruelty.
—Rob

body:
We need to STOP ICE NOW

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/265bc28fb494/she-was-murdered-we-must-act?e=d8fee79be0)

| | | | | |

####

Dear friend,
I wish I were writing under different circumstances. But I cannot let yesterday’s events go unaccounted for.
Renee Good was driving away. We saw the video. We cannot be lied to. She was driving away and before that she was protesting peacefully and they shot her for it. Renee Nicole Good was murdered by ICE. We have to call it what it is. She was shot and killed in cold blood by a federal agent.
ICE is out of control. They have been weaponized and set loose and there’s no telling who will be next. I am shaken.
What happened in Minneapolis isn’t isolated. It’s part of an immigration system that has turned violent against the very citizens it is supposed to serve. What we are seeing is domestic terrorism enacted by a federal agency.
That fear doesn’t stop at state lines. It reaches families here in Utah, too, who worry every day about who’s watching, who’s knocking, and whether their loved ones will come home.
We cannot live in this atmosphere of fear, of federally mandated violence in which an out-of-control executive branch feels empowered to murder its own people.
Fear isn’t freedom.
We deserve dignity. We deserve humanity. We deserve an immigration system that protects people instead of terrorizing them.
The first step is to demand more from our leaders. I will be a voice for our immigrant communities in Congress; **from day one I will work to dismantle and defund ICE** , to fire Kristi Noem and invoke an investigation.
I’m asking you to [**help us gather signatures**](https://evaforutah.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6342e1b77dc7bd1318499db40&id=1b613bd68d&e=d8fee79be0) to get my name on the Congressional ballot, because I never want what happened in Minnesota to ever happen again, here in Utah or anywhere else.
It’s time to abolish ICE, to end state‐sponsored violence, and to build a future where families in Utah and everywhere are safe and welcome. Justice for Renee. ICE out of Minneapolis. ICE out of Utah.

Le acompaño en su dolor,
**Eva López Chávez**

clean_body: We need to STOP ICE NOW | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Dear friend, I wish I were writing under different circumstances. But I cannot let yesterday’s events go unaccounted for. Renee Good was driving away. We saw the video. We cannot be lied to. She was driving away and before that she was protesting peacefully and they shot her for it. Renee Nicole Good was murdered by ICE. We have to call it what it is. She was shot and killed in cold blood by a federal agent. ICE is out of control. They have been weaponized and set loose and there’s no telling who will be next. I am shaken. What happened in Minneapolis isn’t isolated. It’s part of an immigration system that has turned violent against the very citizens it is supposed to serve. What we are seeing is domestic terrorism enacted by a federal agency. That fear doesn’t stop at state lines. It reaches families here in Utah, too, who worry every day about who’s watching, who’s knocking, and whether their loved ones will come home. We cannot live in this atmosphere of fear, of federally mandated violence in which an out-of-control executive branch feels empowered to murder its own people. Fear isn’t freedom. We deserve dignity. We deserve humanity. We deserve an immigration system that protects people instead of terrorizing them. The first step is to demand more from our leaders. I will be a voice for our immigrant communities in Congress; from day one I will work to dismantle and defund ICE , to fire Kristi Noem and invoke an investigation. I’m asking you to to get my name on the Congressional ballot, because I never want what happened in Minnesota to ever happen again, here in Utah or anywhere else. It’s time to abolish ICE, to end state‐sponsored violence, and to build a future where families in Utah and everywhere are safe and welcome. Justice for Renee. ICE out of Minneapolis. ICE out of Utah. Le acompaño en su dolor, Eva López Chávez | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2026 Friends of Eva Lopez Chavez. All rights reserved.

---
Every January, most people set resolutions. Paratroopers don’t set resolutions. We set missions. And this year, I have one mission: **Protect the country I love. ** **I’m Captain Mike Bouchard — Army Paratrooper, Iraq veteran, Bronze Star recipient, and proud Michigan conservative.** _Last year, I spent nine months in a war zone — safeguarding over 6,000 coalition troops, leading missions to destroy ISIS, and watching firsthand what happens when America leads with strength._ This year, I’m stepping into a different kind of fight - but one that matters just as much.
---
[ **STAND WITH A VET >>** ](http://links.gopwins.info/u/click?_t=98057da4e99f4c609080f212fe1184e1&_m=617af570f9844cd68c8eeed0d6cca805&_e=1r7-IiI8NEOTNN3BDu2zDNL7wPARQoeWuyMuC6VSB4EqZBoHvbSyN1P88MekVo51zU_e_ToyUuhGKz1aB4dd3Ls6AyKjQXdtQHvKdO_TCBEWsjOJNxbUxFb37E1RW9xxD2U_S7KepAGeIxTqHn_LR6pwI6H2tWOHACJ40xzlFKpxuXDd_Q-Yq1WvpLEzMyPMsxe6Q-3CLVnrQ2A0jb9AQnjqcBwRySNXmpBNGwBCOLaFE3w6YLwlWom_EuoHuk7XHTAuP-_OryYqkJBrnDcdjCeTvrHo4-E6MS4LCIGN1Hc9GMZDt-N5srdSA1abD1ajdoHr4G_ccIV165TER4ny7RS1AKsVK-fGGR-FrtG5_gnS_NRRWSDqDItdz85oa5jfUi7LRgNcRFxePTgZ6OJj3XWyGJdV6GlcnyS9xYtt5PE-dTi4j6iJz-v-z65v5RJuzfMOhDvVGfDj3ViFTgVYF7bPRaUtl-OOEKJLKW6UiY-cXNdax7CdVtUmuQMZLJh4AXw9SAyseIbpKVCt8-xBHeRCtMp3HuDlpwWr3GcEjbPDKnbOPu5mhkG-iEVdTNGN)
---
Because the threats our country faces aren’t only overseas. They’re right here at home:
_Open borders._

clean_body: This year, the fight for America gets personal. | | | Every January, most people set resolutions. Paratroopers don’t set resolutions. We set missions. And this year, I have one mission: Protect the country I love. I’m Captain Mike Bouchard — Army Paratrooper, Iraq veteran, Bronze Star recipient, and proud Michigan conservative. Last year, I spent nine months in a war zone — safeguarding over 6,000 coalition troops, leading missions to destroy ISIS, and watching firsthand what happens when America leads with strength. This year, I’m stepping into a different kind of fight - but one that matters just as much. Because the threats our country faces aren’t only overseas. They’re right here at home: Open borders. Inflation crushing working families. A government that forgot who it works for. An economy that left Michigan behind. I didn’t jump out of airplanes and serve in two of America’s most elite divisions to sit on the sidelines while politicians tear this nation apart. So here’s my January mission: Build the strongest, most disciplined grassroots team in the entire country. Together, we will restore strength in Washington and pride in America. subject: The Mountain Minute: 1/9/2026
body:
Fascist Regime? CU Boulder Newsletter Tests University Speech Policies
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
If you're in the Denver metro area, we've got a fun event to share with you for this weekend! Kick off 2026 at **[The Golden Summit](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** —an evening bringing together conservative leaders, candidates, and grassroots voices committed to rebuilding Colorado’s future. You'll enjoy live music, BBQ, and meaningful conversation at The Club at Rolling Hills, featuring Jeff Hunt, Nicole Hunt, Heidi Ganahl, and House Minority Leader Jarvis Caldwell. Tickets are moving fast, don't miss it!
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Colorado is bracing for a turbulent 2026 as lawmakers [prepare for a divisive session](https://link.email.joinrmv.) marked by urban-rural tensions and fights over public safety and local control. [New gun purchase requirements](https://link.email.joinrmv.) have drawn sharp Second Amendment backlash, while Loveland moved to [reset homelessness enforcement](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and Douglas County recommitted to [resisting state overreach](https://link.email.joinrmv.) despite a failed home rule vote. CU Boulder also came under fire after an official newsletter labeled the federal government a [“fascist authoritarian regime,”](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and Montrose commissioner [Sean Pond entered the U.S. Senate race](https://link.email.joinrmv.) citing federal overreach and affordability concerns.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** National scrutiny intensified as the [Democratic Socialists of America organized protests](https://link.email.joinrmv.) demanding the release of Venezuelan strongman Nicolás Maduro, highlighting long-standing ties to the socialist regime. Meanwhile, media coverage faced backlash for [omitting key details in a Minneapolis incident](https://link.email.joinrmv.) where video shows a suspect allegedly attempting to run over ICE agents—an act DHS called domestic terrorism.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** A new commentary questions Colorado’s [“Safe Starts at Home” program](https://link.email.joinrmv.), warning that folding firearm-storage discussions into government home visits—without transparency on participation or training—blurs the line between voluntary education and government overreach.
This is your Mountain Minute for January 9, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Fascist Regime? CU Boulder Newsletter Tests University Speech Policies](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
“I’m not trying to be divisive, controversial, or polarizing,” insisted Jennifer Ho, director of CU Boulder’s Center for Humanities & the Arts.
But the January newsletter sent under the center’s name and distributed through official university email quickly did exactly that, leveling sweeping accusations against the federal government and blurring the line between personal opinion and institutional speech.
Academic centers send newsletters all the time. What set this one apart was how it arrived — through official university email, bearing the center’s name and branding, with no immediate signal it was anything other than an institutional communication.
That context mattered once readers reached the opening paragraph.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[“I’m not a politician”: Montrose commissioner Sean Pond enters U.S. Senate race](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Running against federal overreach, not for power:** Montrose County commissioner Sean Pond announced his U.S. Senate bid saying he’s “not a politician,” but someone pushed into the race by frustration with federal policies that are driving up costs, shrinking freedoms, and landing hard on local communities.
* **Grounded in real-life experience:** Pond traces his motivation to what he’s heard repeatedly from Coloradans across the state—families can’t afford homes, young couples are delaying kids, and jobs are disappearing—concluding these are consequences of decisions made far from the people they affect.
* **Local fight to national stage:** After stepping into county government to block federal land grabs and seeing how state and federal laws steadily erode individual liberty, Pond says the Senate race is about restoring constitutional balance, protecting public lands, and giving voice to voters tired of top-down rulemaking.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
The Rocky Mountain Voice is a 501(c)(3) that exists to promote informed civic engagement and the principles of self-governance through enterprise reporting on public policy, politics, government, and culture throughout the state of Colorado. The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[When gun storage becomes public health policy in Colorado](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY CORY GAINES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Public health framing expands government reach:** The commentary examines Colorado’s “Safe Starts at Home” program, which trains county workers conducting home visits to initiate conversations about firearm storage and distribute locking devices, signaling a shift toward treating gun ownership as a public health issue rather than a constitutional right.
* **Transparency concerns raise red flags:** While the author supports voluntary, informational safe-storage practices, he questions why program officials refuse to disclose which counties requested participation or to release training materials, arguing secrecy undermines trust when government agents enter private homes.
* **Education vs. soft regulation:** The piece warns that embedding firearm discussions into government home visits blurs the line between education and surveillance, reminding readers that participation is voluntary and citizens are free to decline questions about lawful gun ownership.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)[**If you’re not at the table: Why Matt Soper says counties need leverage now**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JANUARY 7** _Unfunded mandates have become a flashpoint between Denver and Colorado’s counties, with local governments warning they are being asked to do more with less. State Rep. Matt Soper has been vocal in support of counties banding together through the Fix It or Fund It coalition._ ____
[**Mark Baisley Launches U.S. Senate Bid, Shifts Focus From Statehouse to Washington**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JANUARY 7** _Colorado State Senator Mark Baisley has entered the race for U.S. Senate, ending his bid for governor and refocusing his campaign on federal policy decisions he says are driving affordability pressures and limiting Colorado’s ability to chart its own course. Baisley described the shift as a move from state-level problem solving to addressing issues he believes now originate in Washington._ ____
[**All Electric Mandate Or ‘All of The Above’ Energy Policy? You Decide**](https://link.email.joinrmv.) **BY RUSS MINARY | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 6** _In December, Excel Energy shut down electricity along the CO Front Range due to “high winds.” It’s difficult to estimate the costs and impacts for individuals, businesses, homeowners, hospitals and grocery stores. Those who had propane, natural gas or diesel-powered generators were able to weather the storm. Everyone else was out of luck.___

We are witnessing a violent tyranny that treats our streets like a battlefield and our lives as disposable. It doesn’t stop there. These agents are stalking school yards, snatching parents in front of sobbing children and turning places of learning into zones of fear. They have no respect for our laws, our safety, or our humanity. They are criminals out of control. We love our community too much to let this continue. Our local democracy must be our shield. # Hi Everyone!

---
| | **First order of business:** Check your voter registration.You must affiliate as a Democrat in El Paso County, CO by **February 1st, 2026** to participate in EPCO Dem Caucus and Assembly in March.
Go to the Secretary of State’s [Website](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=9d9cc6abf3&e=738470dca6) to check your registration and change your affiliation to Democrat.
**Campaign event: Please join us for a Caucus/Assembly training on****Sunday, January 11th, 2026 between 10am-1pm.****Respond to this email for the address.** If you can’t make it in person we will have an online training Wednesday, January 14th at 6pm.Register [here](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=e49a367dea&e=738470dca6)****
**Then go to the ICE out of Colorado protest in honor of****Renee Nicole Good, the mother murdered by ICE:******
**Here’s a picture from one of Renee friends and a little bit about her:**

**Update on Edwin and Mari: Colorado Springs community member abducted and abused by ICE in Texas and Oklahoma:** We have been able to connect them with local immigrant rights organizations. The Pikes Peak Bulletin just did an [in depth story](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=ffe6c2a6c7&e=738470dca6) and will have updates. Mari was also interviewed on [Don Lemon](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=8807b23084&e=738470dca6). We have also reached out to AG Weiser’s office, three CO US Representatives, and both Colorado Senators.We want to continue to protect Edwin and the four men who (allegedly for legal purposes) witnessed an elderly man being pulled naked out of the shower and then beaten in Blue Bonnet detention facilities in Texas. We do not know the condition of the elderly man who left bloody on a gurney. Here’s a link to the audio recordings from [ICE custody](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=5474c840dc&e=738470dca6)
See you at [Caucus and Assembly in March](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=2be0266708&e=738470dca6).
Let’s fight for a better country.
With heart,Zuri Horowitz

**No Contract, No Coffee.**
****
---

[**Volunteer**](https://zuriforcd5.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0f6e59d8f916735599a3b9efd&id=7dcb65c045&e=738470dca6)**-** Our outreach strategy will rely on volunteers & minimize paper waste. If you haven’t signed up already, please do!

You can thank Donald Trump and Republican extremists in Washington. Nearly every major problem facing our nation is one they caused or are making worse. [**As the daughter of an immigrant, veteran, and police officer, I ran for Congress to fight for working families like the one I come from.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122997810/594132855/318555453?amount=6&amounts=6,15,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_010926_foundingdonor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Mjc5NjNkOC05OGVkLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YB-wl9t_7AgImhfIzlrjDfzTJmUZdAkebPyuJLxA79g=) My family didn’t have much growing up. My dad immigrated to the U.S. in 1950, worked in the fields of the Rio Grande Valley, served two tours in Vietnam, and earned his U.S. citizenship. He proudly achieved the American dream because he believed that through hard work, anything was possible. [**So when I watch Donald Trump and Republicans in Congress attack families like mine, and rip apart the American Dream, it’s not just about politics— _it’s deeply personal._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122997811/594132856/318555453?amount=6&amounts=6,15,25,50,100,250&refcode=email_010926_foundingdonor&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzg4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4Mjc5NjNkOC05OGVkLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YB-wl9t_7AgImhfIzlrjDfzTJmUZdAkebPyuJLxA79g=) As we speak, Republicans in Congress, fueled by Trump and their extreme leaders, are actively pushing to destroy the American dream and make life harder for American families. November’s election is critical — defending my seat and helping Democrats take back the House is the best way to put a check on the far-right’s power, and bring back the American dream. **[For four years, I’ve been on the frontlines defending Oregon families and pushing for real change for Oregon families, but now, I need your help to continue this fight. clean_body: = = | | = Look, being a former Republican isn’t my whole story. My mother immigrated from the Philippines as an organic chemist. I followed in her footsteps and majored in biochemistry before I went to Law School to pursue my true passion – Constitutional Law. Looking back, the Constitution was my first love. At 10, I was obsessed with the Watergate Scandal. (Little did I know that was child's play compared to what Trump would do). I know that sounds boring and nerdy, but the promise of our democracy, freedoms, and the rule of law fascinates me – and for years I thought Republicans upheld those same ideals. I was so wrong. When I finally got a peek under the hood and saw what these lying, sleazebag, horrible MAGA loyalists were doing to our country, I couldn’t stomach it. Since then, I’ve put my money and time where my mouth is. I regret my 2016 vote for Donald Trump every single day – but I need to do more. So I know I’m not your typical Democrat. And I don’t intend to lead like one. body:
You swear an oath to the Constitution when you join the military — including the First Amendment right to free speech. We swore to defend the foundational principles of this country. I took that oath seriously 40 years ago, and I still do.

| Peter,

Pete Hegseth decided he's going to censure me, and is threatening to demote me and reduce my pension.

I got shot at in service to this country. I missed holidays and birthdays. I commanded a space shuttle mission and launched to the International Space Station while my wife recovered from a gunshot wound to the head.

My rank and retirement are things that I earned through my service and sacrifice for this country. Generations of servicemembers have done the same. Pete Hegseth wants to send a message to every single one that he will come after them if they say something he doesn’t like.

You swear an oath to the Constitution when you join the military — including the First Amendment right to free speech. We swore to defend the foundational principles of this country. I took that oath seriously 40 years ago, and I still do.

Pete Hegseth can threaten to reduce my rank and my pension. But I am not going to let him intimidate me, or anyone else. He is not going to stop me from defending our democracy from a president who is hellbent on destroying it.

If they think this is going to shut me up, they’ve got another thing coming.

name: Nellie Pou
subject: It’s the on-year. Let’s win this.
body:
Here’s what I’m fighting for

| |
---
Hi friend, We are officially in the on-year. This is the moment everything has been building toward. This year means constant outreach. It means knocking on doors, making phone calls, running ads, organizing volunteers, and showing up in every corner of the district. It means meeting voters where they are and earning every single vote in one of the most competitive House races in the country. Over the past year, I’ve been focused on doing the work New Jersey sent me to Washington to do. I’ve pushed House Republicans to answer for their role in driving up health care costs and blocking efforts to lower drug prices, and I’ve held this administration accountable. That work matters, and now it’s on the ballot. This race will help decide control of the House. And winning here is not automatic. Outreach at this scale is expensive, especially in a district like ours. The ads, the field program, the staff on the ground, all of it takes real resources to do right. But I’m encouraged because the energy is real. New Jerseyans are ready for leaders who will lower costs, protect our communities, and deliver results instead of excuses. Peter,

As a pediatrician and a mom, I've spent my career protecting the health of children.

This means making sure they get healthy nutrition, plenty of outdoor play, a safe environment, and lots of love from their parents. It also means making sure they get immunized to protect them from infectious diseases that used to cause widespread suffering, hospitalizations, and sometimes death.

I've seen firsthand how vaccines save lives and prevent diseases that used to cripple or kill children.

But as Secretary of Health and Human Services, RFK Jr. is hellbent on limiting the number of immunizations children get. Under his new guidelines, the number would drop from 17 to 10.

Even his own hand-picked immunization advisory panel chock full of anti-vaccination activists didn’t do this! For example, they recommended that children still receive an annual flu vaccine.

But not RFK Jr. He independently decided—based on ideology, not evidence—to no longer recommend that all children be protected from illnesses like flu, rotavirus, meningitis, and RSV. He's personally putting our children at risk based on unfounded personal beliefs.

[**Will you chip in whatever you can to help me fight back against his reckless agenda in Congress?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122998489/594134836/1210615431?refcode=em26_260109_vaccin_fndd_gq_act___KS_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260109_vaccin_fndd_gq_act___KS_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=4d0e9ea6-9aed-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZDBlOWVhNi05YWVkLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=xxw-pZeK_ltkfTmTQDHzLxhb--5bpRt0YcMgwhR45yM=)

Let me be clear: Vaccines are one of the greatest public health achievements of the last century. They are safe, they are effective, and they protect our children and our communities from diseases that used to sicken and even kill children on a regular basis. Rolling back these proven protections doesn't just put individual kids at risk; it puts all of us at risk.

We've seen what happens when vaccine coverage drops. It means more outbreaks of measles, whooping cough, and other preventable diseases. That’s not hypothetical. Last year, children in the United States of America died from measles and pertussis!

**We're talking about real harm that will be done and real human lives that will be needlessly lost all because one unqualified conspiracy theorist has been given the reins to our nation's public health.**

We need to fight back, and we need to do it now. RFK Jr.'s anti-vaccine agenda is a dangerous step backward, and we need leaders in Congress who will stand up for truth, for kids, and for families. I'm fighting every day to protect access to healthcare, to support evidence-based medicine, and to keep politics out of our doctors' offices. But I can't do it alone.

As a proud and patriotic immigrant, I want every kid to have the same shot I had — the shot that allowed me to give back to this country.
But today, millions of kids and families are being denied that same chance. So I’m asking you to stand with me and demand real, comprehensive immigration reform.
[ADD MY NAME](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122998842/594135943/-1909961190?refcode=260109_RG_personal-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDdhNjE3Ny05Y2VkLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=131LbXQ7qrBeu8KvHfDwJRcG7xPTx5XzD_LuiObsTRQ=&emci=c4298124-94ed-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&emdi=e47a6177-9ced-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&ceid=16877361)
My mom brought me to this country not knowing English and without an education. But thanks to a progressive immigration law passed by Congress in the 1980s, we were able to apply for permanent legal residency. I became a U.S. citizen in my early 20s.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122998843/594135944/-1909961190?refcode=260109_RG_personal-pet-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDdhNjE3Ny05Y2VkLWYwMTEtODE5NC0wMDBkM2ExMWY5MDMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=131LbXQ7qrBeu8KvHfDwJRcG7xPTx5XzD_LuiObsTRQ=&emci=c4298124-94ed-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&emdi=e47a6177-9ced-f011-8194-000d3a11f903&ceid=16877361)
_**That act of Congress changed everything. **_
America gave me the opportunity to go to school, to serve my community, and to become the first LGBTQ immigrant ever elected to Congress. I know my story isn’t typical, but it should be. I believe every family should have access to that same pathway to success.
Right now, Congress should be an institution that helps people — not one that blocks progress or plays politics with families’ futures. But we’re facing big, structural challenges:
* Generational poverty
* Concentrated wealth and power
* Attacks on democracy
* Systemic racism
* And a fringe minority inside the GOP is determined to stop any meaningful immigration reform

I’ve seen firsthand that coalitions can be built — even when the opposition is entrenched, ideological, and loud. We can do big things when we insist on justice and fight for opportunity.
**That’s why I need you with me. Congress cannot keep punting on this. Families cannot wait. clean_body: This is personal for me = As a proud and patriotic immigrant, I want every kid to have the same shot I had — the shot that allowed me to give back to this country. But today, millions of kids and families are being denied that same chance. So I’m asking you to stand with me and demand real, comprehensive immigration reform. My mom brought me to this country not knowing English and without an education. But thanks to a progressive immigration law passed by Congress in the 1980s, we were able to apply for permanent legal residency. I became a U.S. citizen in my early 20s. That act of Congress changed everything. America gave me the opportunity to go to school, to serve my community, and to become the first LGBTQ immigrant ever elected to Congress. I know my story isn’t typical, but it should be. I believe every family should have access to that same pathway to success. Right now, Congress should be an institution that helps people — not one that blocks progress or plays politics with families’ futures. But we’re facing big, structural challenges: Generational poverty Concentrated wealth and power Attacks on democracy Systemic racism And a fringe minority inside the GOP is determined to stop any meaningful immigration reform I’ve seen firsthand that coalitions can be built — even when the opposition is entrenched, ideological, and loud. We can do big things when we insist on justice and fight for opportunity. That’s why I need you with me. Congress cannot keep punting on this. Families cannot wait. Kids cannot wait. ** Thank you for believing in a more compassionate, inclusive, and hopeful America.
